context_rows.text: Numeric properties are saved as the text representation of unsigned decimal integers. The property value MUST be in the range from zero through 4294967295. The text representation MUST conform to the following ABNF [RFC4234] grammar:
The text representation is determined using the following algorithm:

steps.text: Treat the property value as an unsigned 32-bit integer, Value.
Allocate a string buffer, String, with room for at least 11 characters.
Set the CurrentCharacter pointer to point to the beginning of String.
Set FirstDigit pointer to point to the beginning of String.
Repeat steps 5.1 through 5.4 until Value is equal to zero.
Set an unsigned 32-bit integer DigitValue to Value modulo 10.
Set Value to Value divided by 10.
Set the character pointed to by CurrentCharacter to DigitValue plus 48, which is the numeric value of the character ‘0’.
Increment CurrentCharacter to point to the next character in String.
Set the character pointed to by CurrentCharacter to zero (NULL).
Decrement CurrentCharacter to point to the previous character in String.
Repeat steps 8.1 through 8.3 until FirstDigit points to a character in String past the character to which CurrentCharacter points.
Swap the values of the characters pointed to by FirstDigit and CurrentCharacter.
Increment FirstDigit to point to the next character in String.
Decrement CurrentCharacter to point to the previous character in String.

context_rows.text: This section specifies the algorithms used to determine which method or property of a type information supports a way of fetching rows of data sequentially, getting the data from those rows, and managing rows of data.
The following are used in the algorithms specified in section 2.6.1.1 and section 2.6.1.2:
TYPEFLAG_FDUAL and the TYPEFLAGS type are specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.16.
INVOKE_PROPERTYPUT, INVOKE_PROPERTYGET, and the INVOKEKIND type are specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.14.
VT_PTR and other VARIANT type constants are specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.7.
The result of the following algorithm can determine the property value of the DispidRowset field of a ClassInfoDataBlock.

steps.text: CALL the GetTypeAttr method of this type information returning TYPEATTR ta.
IF ta.wTypeFlags and TYPEFLAG_FDUAL THEN
FOR each function in this type information
CALL the GetFuncDesc method of this type information with the index of this function, returning FUNCDESC fd.
IF fd.lprgelemdescParam is NOT EQUAL TO zero AND fd.invkind is EQUAL TO INVOKE_PROPERTYPUT THEN
SET TYPEDESC td to fd.lprgelemdescParam.tdesc.
IF td.vt is EQUAL TO VT_PTR THEN
SET td to td.lptdesc.
END IF
IF td.vt is EQUAL TO VT_USERDEFINED THEN
SET HREFTYPE hr to td.hreftype.
CALL the GetRefTypeInfo of this type information with hr, returning ITypeInfo ti2.
CALL the GetTypeAttr method of ti2, returning TYPEATTR ta2.
IF ta2.guid is EQUAL TO {0C733A52-2A1C-11CE-ADE5-00AA0044773D} THEN
RETURN fd.memid.
END IF
END IF
END IF
END FOR
ELSE
FOR each data property in this type information
CALL the GetVarDesc method of this type information with the index of this property, returning VARDESC vd.
SET td to vd.elemdescVar.tdesc.
IF td.vt is EQUAL TO VT_PTR THEN
SET td to td.lptdesc.
END IF
IF td.vt is EQUAL TO VT_USERDEFINED THEN
SET HREFTYPE hr to td.hreftype.
CALL the GetRefTypeInfo of this type information with hr, returning ITypeInfo ti2.
CALL the GetTypeAttr method of ti2, returning TYPEATTR ta2.
IF ta2.guid is EQUAL TO {0C733A52-2A1C-11CE-ADE5-00AA0044773D} THEN
RETURN vd.memid.
END IF
END IF
END FOR
END IF

IF ta.wTypeFlags and TYPEFLAG_FDUAL THEN

mapping_sources.text: A Frame control is a parent control that is persisted in binary format as specified in section 2.1.2.1.1. In other words, it consists of a FormControl stored in a Form stream, with any child controls stored in an Object stream, as specified in section 2.1.2.2. If the Frame control is the child of another control, it is persisted to a storage as specified in section 2.1.2.2.2, with its child objects persisted to the Object stream within the parent storage.

persistence_dependencies.source_text: A Frame control is a parent control that is persisted in binary format as specified in section 2.1.2.1.1. In other words, it consists of a FormControl stored in a Form stream, with any child controls stored in an Object stream, as specified in section 2.1.2.2. If the Frame control is the child of another control, it is persisted to a storage as specified in section 2.1.2.2.2, with its child objects persisted to the Object stream within the parent storage.

mapping_sources.text: The MorphDataControl structure is an aggregate of six controls: CheckBox, ComboBox, ListBox, OptionButton, TextBox, and ToggleButton. The type of the control is specified by the DisplayStyle property. This section specifies the persistence format for all six controls.

A MultiPage control that is persisted in a binary format uses the storage and streams specified in section 2.1.2.1 and section 2.1.2.2. It consists of a FormControl, which is stored in the Form stream, a TabStripControl, which is stored in the Object stream, and multiple Page controls, which are stored as specified in section 2.1.2.2.2.

The storage of a MultiPage control also contains an additional stream, which MUST be named "x". This stream contains an array of PageProperties immediately followed by a MultiPageProperties. The number of elements in the array of PageProperties MUST be set to 1 plus the value of DataBlock.PageCount of the MultiPageProperties. The first PageProperties in the array MUST be ignored. The remaining elements specify one PageProperties for each Page in the control. The order of the Pages is specified by the value of the ExtraDataBlock.Items of the TabStripControl specified in the previous paragraph.
MultiPage controls are parent controls. They are persisted in binary format as specified in section 2.1.2. This section specifies the format of the MultiPage control as persisted in the "x" stream.

persistence_dependencies.source_text: A MultiPage control that is persisted in a binary format uses the storage and streams specified in section 2.1.2.1 and section 2.1.2.2. It consists of a FormControl, which is stored in the Form stream, a TabStripControl, which is stored in the Object stream, and multiple Page controls, which are stored as specified in section 2.1.2.2.2.

The storage of a MultiPage control also contains an additional stream, which MUST be named "x". This stream contains an array of PageProperties immediately followed by a MultiPageProperties. The number of elements in the array of PageProperties MUST be set to 1 plus the value of DataBlock.PageCount of the MultiPageProperties. The first PageProperties in the array MUST be ignored. The remaining elements specify one PageProperties for each Page in the control. The order of the Pages is specified by the value of the ExtraDataBlock.Items of the TabStripControl specified in the previous paragraph.

mapping_sources.text: The Page control (section 2.1.2.3.1) is an example of an embedded parent control. It exists only within a MultiPage control (section 2.1.2.3), and each Page control is a UserForm (section 2.2.10) that exists as a storage with its own streams that persist FormControl (section 2.2.10.1) properties and information about its child controls. Properties of the Page control independent of the UserForm, are stored by its parent MultiPage control. The MultiPage control adds the "x" stream to hold its MultiPageProperties (section 2.2.6) and the PageProperties (section 2.2.6.4) of each of its Pages.

A Page MUST be stored as part of a MultiPage control. A Page that is persisted in a binary format uses the storage and streams specified in section 2.1.2.1 and section 2.1.2.2.2. It consists of a FormControl, which is stored in the Form stream, optional embedded controls in the Object stream, and a PageProperties, which is stored in the "x" stream of its parent control, as specified in section 2.1.2.3.
Page controls are parent controls. They are persisted in binary format as specified in section 2.1.2. This section specifies the format of the Page control.

It consists of a FormControl, which is stored in the Form stream, optional embedded controls in the Object stream, and a PageProperties, which is stored in the "x" stream of its parent control, as specified in section 2.1.2.3.

mapping_sources.text: All parent controls MUST contain a FormControl. The FormControl properties are persisted to a stream as specified in section 2.1.1.2. The name of this stream MUST be "f". An OleSiteConcrete is persisted in this stream for each embedded control, as specified by the FormControl in section 2.2.10.12. The FormControl can also contain a DesignExtender, as specified in section 2.2.10.11.
Forms are parent controls. They are persisted in binary format as specified in section 2.1.2. This section specifies the format of the Form stream.

documented_unknowns.heading: Property Mask
documented_unknowns.text: The property mask is a 4-byte or 8-byte bit field that specifies the property values of a control that are persisted. Each property that applies to a control is represented by a bit in the property mask of that control. Some bits in each property mask are unused, as specified per control in section 2.2. The lowest-order used bit in a property mask specifies whether the property to which it corresponds, which would be persisted first, is in fact stored, and the highest-order used bit specifies the presence of the property that would be persisted last.

documented_unknowns.heading: Padding and Alignment
documented_unknowns.text: Property values stored in the DataBlock portion of a control MUST be stored on alignment boundaries equal to the size of the property value, relative to the beginning of the control in the stream. All 4-byte property values MUST be stored beginning at an offset into the stream, from the beginning of the version number, that is divisible by 4. All 2-byte property values MUST be stored at an offset into the stream, from the beginning of the version number, that is divisible by 2. Extra bytes MUST be added to the stream before any property value that would otherwise be stored starting at an unaligned offset. The value of each of these bytes is undefined, and the bytes MUST be ignored. Padding MUST NOT be added before a property value that is not stored.

documented_unknowns.heading: Padding and Alignment
documented_unknowns.text: After all property values that are less than or equal to 4 bytes in size have been persisted to the stream, extra bytes MUST be added so that the total size, in bytes, of all persisted property values and padding is divisible by 4. The value of these extra bytes at the end of the DataBlock MUST be set to zero, and the bytes MUST be ignored.

documented_unknowns.heading: MultiPage Control Structure
documented_unknowns.text: The storage of a MultiPage control also contains an additional stream, which MUST be named "x". This stream contains an array of PageProperties immediately followed by a MultiPageProperties. The order of the Pages is specified by the value of the ExtraDataBlock.Items of the TabStripControl specified in the previous paragraph.

product_behavior.referenced_text: I - Alignment (1 bit): Specifies the position of the Caption relative to the control. A value of 1 specifies that the Caption is to the left of the control, and a value of zero specifies that the Caption is to the right of the control.<15>
product_behavior.statement: Office Forms displays the two values for the Alignment property as "0 - fmAlignmentLeft" and "1 - fmAlignmentRight" in the Properties Window of the designer. However, the file format specifies that VariousPropertyBits.Alignment is set to 1 for "0 - fmAlignmentLeft" and set to zero for "1 - fmAlignmentRight".

product_behavior.referenced_text: J - Editable (1 bit): Specifies whether the user can type into the control. MUST be set to 1 for TextBox controls. MUST be set to 1 for ComboBox controls in which the DisplayStyle property is set to 0x03 (fmDisplayStyleCombo). SHOULD be set to zero for ComboBox controls in which the DisplayStyle property is set to 0x07 (fmDisplayStyleDropList), but MAY be set to 1, and MUST be ignored.<16>
product_behavior.statement: The Editable property of a ComboBox control is set to 1 when it is persisted with the DisplayStyle property set to fmDisplayStyleCombo. The Editable property is not set to zero when the control is persisted with the DisplayStyle property set to fmDisplayStyleDropList. Instead, it retains the same value for the Editable property as the value it had the last time it was persisted. Applications make requests to Office Forms controls to persist themselves at times other than when the user chooses to save a document, so the Editable property can be set to 1, even if the implementer changes the Style property of a new ComboBox to "2 - fmStyleDropDownList" in the Properties Window of the designer before saving.

sections.heading: Relationship to Protocols and Other Structures

source_rows.heading: Saving Controls
source_rows.text: Office Forms controls can be stored by serializing control properties to an IStream interface, an IStorage interface, or an IPropertyBag interface. For more information about these interfaces, see [MSDN-IStream], [MSDN-IStorage], and [MSDN-IPropertyBag], respectively. Parent controls, that is, controls that can contain other controls are stored to an IStorage interface. Non-parent controls that are not embedded in another control can be saved to any of the three interfaces.

source_rows.heading: Saving Controls
source_rows.text: All Office Forms controls can be saved to PowerPoint, Word, and Excel file formats, as well as any other file types that support the IStorage and IStream interfaces. For more information about the PowerPoint, Word, and Excel binary formats, see [MS-PPT], [MS-DOC], and [MS-XLS], respectively. For information about Excel Binary File Format (.xlsb), see [MS-XLSB]. Excel Binary File Format (.xlsb) also supports IPropertyBag, so non-parent controls that are not embedded in another control can be saved to that file format using IPropertyBag.

source_rows.heading: Saving Controls
source_rows.text: Each client application provides the desired interface to Office Forms. This document describes how Office Forms are written to these interfaces. It does not describe how the bytes are saved to disk; that format is determined by the client application.

source_rows.heading: Saving Controls
source_rows.text: The rest of this section describes how controls are saved to the IStream and IStorage formats.

source_rows.heading: Control Properties
source_rows.text: Office Forms controls are stored as collections of property values. Any information required to identify the control is stored by the client application. For example, the client application can write the class identifier (CLSID) of the control, which is a GUID, to the stream before passing it to the control. For more information about the GUID type, see [MS-DTYP].

source_rows.heading: Control Properties
source_rows.text: If a client application requests that a non-parent Office Forms control be saved to a storage, Office Forms creates a stream named "contents" under the storage provided by the client application and persists the control to that stream in the same way that it would persist to any IStream object.

source_rows.heading: Control Properties
source_rows.text: Once an Office Forms control is given or creates a stream object, the control properties are stored in a fixed format. Metadata is stored about the properties, including flags to indicate which properties are stored. Properties that are 4 bytes or smaller in size are stored sequentially in the DataBlock, followed by larger properties in the ExtraData block. Properties that are stored using the IPersistStream interface are stored in StreamData. For more information about IPersistStream, see [MSDN-IPersistStream]. The following figure illustrates this layout.

source_rows.heading: Control Properties
source_rows.text: Figure 18: Control structure without additional data

source_rows.heading: Control Properties
source_rows.text: Some controls store additional data, which is not depicted in this figure. Any additional data is stored in the stream directly following this format. Many controls store TextProps (section 2.3.1) immediately following StreamData. The TextProps structure follows the pattern illustrated in this figure. These additional data structures are specified in the section specific to the applicable control.

source_rows.heading: Parent Controls
source_rows.text: Parent controls are those, such as Frame, that can contain other controls. These controls are considered parents whether or not they contain embedded controls. The structure of a parent control consists of multiple streams in one storage. The following figure illustrates this layout.

source_rows.heading: Parent Controls
source_rows.text: The first stream, named "f", is the Form stream (section 2.1.2.1.1). The Form stream contains the properties of the parent control, followed by the ClassTable (section 2.2.10.10), which stores information about control types that are used by embedded controls and are unknown to the parent control. Following the ClassTable, the Sites array (section 1.3.2.2.2) of the FormSiteData (section 2.2.10.6) stores information about each control embedded in the parent control. Following the Sites array (section 1.3.2.2.2), the DesignExtender (section 2.2.10.11) stores properties of the design surface of the parent control. The ClassTable (section 2.2.10.10) and DesignExtender (section 2.2.10.11) are both optional and are not stored if not needed.

source_rows.heading: Parent Controls
source_rows.text: The second stream, named "o", is the Object stream (section 2.1.2.2.1). The Object stream contains the properties of each embedded child control, persisted as described in section 1.3.2.1. Embedded child controls cannot be parent controls. Embedded parent controls are described in section 1.3.2.3.

source_rows.heading: Parent Controls
source_rows.text: The CompObj stream (section 2.1.2.4) holds information about the parent control and clipboard formats.

source_rows.heading: Parent Controls
source_rows.text: Parent controls can create other streams in addition to the Form stream (section 2.1.2.1.1) and Object stream (section 2.1.2.2.1), as long as the additional streams have names unique to their storage.

source_rows.heading: ClassTable
source_rows.text: The format of the ClassTable element in the Form stream (section 2.1.2.1.1) is a count of classes, followed sequentially by information about each class.

source_rows.heading: Sites Array
source_rows.text: The format of the Sites array, as illustrated in the following figure, is a count of embedded controls, followed by the size of the embedded control information, an array describing the types, and an array describing each site.

source_rows.heading: Sites Array
source_rows.text: The SiteDepthsAndTypes array, as illustrated in the previous figure, stores the depth as specified in section 2.2.10.7 and type of each embedded control. Each entry is 2 or 3 bytes long, depending on whether two consecutive controls are of the same OLE type. If two or more controls of the same type occur in order, only one entry is used. That entry includes a count, as well as the depth and type. The array is padded to a length that is divisible by 4. The Sites array in the previous figure is an array of OleSiteConcreteControl structures (section 2.2.10.12), one for each embedded control.

source_rows.heading: Embedded Parent Controls
source_rows.text: An embedded control can also be a parent control to control(s) embedded in it. In that case, the properties of the embedded parent control are not stored in the parent Object stream (section 2.1.2.2.1) with the information about its siblings, but rather as a storage contained by the parent control storage. Each embedded parent control is still accounted for in the parent SiteDepthsAndTypes array, as described in section 1.3.2.2.2.

source_rows.heading: Embedded Parent Controls
source_rows.text: The Page control (section 2.1.2.3.1) is an example of an embedded parent control. It exists only within a MultiPage control (section 2.1.2.3), and each Page control is a UserForm (section 2.2.10) that exists as a storage with its own streams that persist FormControl (section 2.2.10.1) properties and information about its child controls. Properties of the Page control independent of the UserForm, are stored by its parent MultiPage control. The MultiPage control adds the "x" stream to hold its MultiPageProperties (section 2.2.6) and the PageProperties (section 2.2.6.4) of each of its Pages.

source_rows.heading: Byte Ordering
source_rows.text: Data in this file format is stored in little-endian format.

source_rows.heading: Byte Ordering
source_rows.text: Some computer architectures number bytes in a binary word from left to right, which is referred to as big-endian. The packet diagrams specified in [MSDN-IDPD] for this documentation are big-endian. Other architectures number the bytes in a binary word from right to left, which is referred to as little-endian. The underlying file format enumerations, objects, and records are little-endian.

source_rows.heading: Relationship to Protocols and Other Structures
source_rows.text: This file format is used as part of a host persistence format that specifies how and where the structures specified in this document are persisted. This structure is dependent on the host persistence formats specified in the following references:

source_rows.heading: Relationship to Protocols and Other Structures
source_rows.text: [MS-PPT] for the persistence format for presentations.

source_rows.heading: Relationship to Protocols and Other Structures
source_rows.text: [MS-DOC] for the persistence format for word-processing documents.

source_rows.heading: Relationship to Protocols and Other Structures
source_rows.text: [MS-XLS] and [MS-XLSB] for the persistence formats for spreadsheets.

source_rows.heading: Relationship to Protocols and Other Structures
source_rows.text: [MS-OVBA] for the persistence format of a code project.

source_rows.heading: Relationship to Protocols and Other Structures
source_rows.text: The host persistence format also specifies whether this structure is persisted in binary or text format. For example, if the host specifies persisting Office Forms controls in text format, it also specifies a property bag [MSDN-IPropertyBag] into which to persist those properties.

source_rows.heading: Relationship to Protocols and Other Structures
source_rows.text: If the host persistence format specifies persisting Office Forms controls in binary format, it also specifies a stream [MSDN-IStream] or storage [MSDN-IStorage] into which to persist those properties, as specified by the Compound File Binary File Format [MS-CFB].

source_rows.heading: Relationship to Protocols and Other Structures
source_rows.text: The OLE Automation Protocol, as specified in [MS-OAUT], is used to embed ActiveX controls that are not specified in this document.

source_rows.heading: Applicability Statement
source_rows.text: This document specifies a persistence format for Office Forms ActiveX controls. The controls typically represent different ways of communicating information or receiving user input through a window or dialog box.

source_rows.heading: Applicability Statement
source_rows.text: This persistence format provides interoperability with applications that create or read documents conforming to this structure.<1>

source_rows.heading: Versioning and Localization
source_rows.text: This document covers versioning issues in the following areas:

source_rows.heading: Versioning and Localization
source_rows.text: Structure Versions: There is only one version of the Office Forms structure.

source_rows.heading: Versioning and Localization
source_rows.text: Localization: This structure defines no locale-specific processes or data.

source_rows.heading: Vendor-Extensible Fields
source_rows.text: The Office Forms structure does not define any vendor extensible fields.

source_rows.heading: File Structure
source_rows.text: Controls can be persisted to a file in two ways: binary format or text format. Text format is specified in section 2.1.1.1. Binary format is specified in section 2.1.1.2 and the following sections.

source_rows.heading: File Structure
source_rows.text: Unless otherwise specified, section 2.1.1.2 and following refer to binary format.

source_rows.heading: File Structure
source_rows.text: NOTE: In this document, the word property refers specifically to named properties specified in section 2.5. Each property has a file format default, which is the value of the property if the property is not stored. This value MUST NOT be persisted.

source_rows.heading: Control Storage Format
source_rows.text: Controls are stored to a file by persisting properties of the control and other control-specific information. For each control structure in section 2.2, a specified set of properties applies and other properties MUST NOT be persisted.

source_rows.heading: Persistence to a Property Bag
source_rows.text: Non-parent controls cannot contain other controls. If non-parent controls are not embedded in other controls, they can be persisted to a property bag. The location and format of the control in the file is specified by the client application that stores it.

source_rows.heading: Persistence to a Property Bag
source_rows.text: Parent controls can contain other controls. They cannot be persisted to a property bag; they MUST be persisted to a storage as specified in section 2.1.2.1. Consequently, controls that are embedded in another control cannot be persisted to a property bag. They MUST be persisted as specified in section 2.1.2.2.

source_rows.heading: Control-specific Properties
source_rows.text: A control that is persisted to a property bag is saved as a series of name-value pairs, where the first element in the pair is the name of a property that applies to the control, and the second element in the pair is the text representation of that property value in that control. The properties, their names, their meanings, and the controls to which they apply are specified in section 2.5.

source_rows.heading: Control-specific Properties
source_rows.text: The format of the text representation of properties is specified in section 2.1.1.1.3. Properties that are not stored in a list and have the same value as the file format default MUST NOT be stored. Storage of properties in a list is specified in section 2.1.1.1.3.6.

source_rows.heading: Additional Persisted Properties
source_rows.text: In addition to the properties in section 2.5 that apply to a control, certain controls save other properties, as specified in the following subsections. These additional properties MUST be stored in the same property bag as the control-specific properties.

source_rows.heading: TextProps
source_rows.text: The following controls, when persisted to a property bag, also store properties that apply to TextProps in section 2.5:

source_rows.heading: TabFlagData
source_rows.text: The TabStrip control, when persisted to a property bag, also stores a property named "TabState", which specifies the state of each tab. The value of this property MUST contain exactly one TabFlag for each tab and MUST conform to the following Augmented Backus-Naur Form (ABNF) [RFC4234] grammar:

source_rows.text: TabFlag: Specifies the state of a tab with one of the values in the following table.

source_rows.heading: TabFlagData
source_rows.text: The tab is neither visible nor enabled.

source_rows.heading: TabFlagData
source_rows.text: The tab is visible but not enabled.

source_rows.heading: TabFlagData
source_rows.text: The tab is enabled, but not visible.

source_rows.heading: TabFlagData
source_rows.text: The tab is both visible and enabled.

source_rows.text: Allocate a string buffer, String, with room for at least 11 characters.

source_rows.heading: Number Properties
source_rows.text: Set the CurrentCharacter pointer to point to the beginning of String.

source_rows.heading: Number Properties
source_rows.text: Set FirstDigit pointer to point to the beginning of String.

source_rows.heading: Number Properties
source_rows.text: Repeat steps 5.1 through 5.4 until Value is equal to zero.

source_rows.heading: Number Properties
source_rows.text: Set an unsigned 32-bit integer DigitValue to Value modulo 10.

source_rows.heading: Number Properties
source_rows.text: Set Value to Value divided by 10.

source_rows.heading: Number Properties
source_rows.text: Set the character pointed to by CurrentCharacter to DigitValue plus 48, which is the numeric value of the character ‘0’.

source_rows.heading: Number Properties
source_rows.text: Increment CurrentCharacter to point to the next character in String.

source_rows.heading: Number Properties
source_rows.text: Set the character pointed to by CurrentCharacter to zero (NULL).

source_rows.heading: Number Properties
source_rows.text: Decrement CurrentCharacter to point to the previous character in String.

source_rows.heading: Number Properties
source_rows.text: Repeat steps 8.1 through 8.3 until FirstDigit points to a character in String past the character to which CurrentCharacter points.

source_rows.heading: Number Properties
source_rows.text: Swap the values of the characters pointed to by FirstDigit and CurrentCharacter.

source_rows.heading: Number Properties
source_rows.text: Increment FirstDigit to point to the next character in String.

source_rows.heading: Number Properties
source_rows.text: Decrement CurrentCharacter to point to the previous character in String.

source_rows.heading: Picture Properties
source_rows.text: Properties that are pictures are persisted as a variant type of VT_UNKNOWN. The location and format of the stored binary value are defined by the client application requesting that the control be persisted.

source_rows.heading: String Properties
source_rows.text: Properties that are strings are saved as Unicode strings with a variant type of VT_BSTR. Empty strings are valid values. String property values that are persisted to a property bag are not compressed or padded and MUST conform to the following ABNF [RFC4234] grammar:

source_rows.heading: Lists of Properties
source_rows.text: TabStrip controls have properties that can have a different value for each tab. Values for these properties MUST be stored and MUST be persisted as a semicolon-delimited list. The list MUST have an entry for each tab and MUST be ordered, with the first element in each list corresponding to the first tab, and so on.

source_rows.heading: Persistence to a Stream
source_rows.text: The location of a control within the structure of the file to which it is persisted is specified by the client application that provides the stream. The exact format of each control as persisted to a stream is specified in section 2.2.

source_rows.heading: Persistence to a Stream
source_rows.text: Each control that is persisted to a stream has the same general structure, as follows:

source_rows.heading: Property Mask
source_rows.text: The property mask is a 4-byte or 8-byte bit field that specifies the property values of a control that are persisted. Each property that applies to a control is represented by a bit in the property mask of that control. Some bits in each property mask are unused, as specified per control in section 2.2. The lowest-order used bit in a property mask specifies whether the property to which it corresponds, which would be persisted first, is in fact stored, and the highest-order used bit specifies the presence of the property that would be persisted last.

source_rows.heading: Property Mask
source_rows.text: The value of each used bit specifies whether the corresponding property of the control has a value that is different from the file format default for that property; that is, whether it is stored. Properties that are not stored in an array and have the same value as the file format default MUST NOT be stored. Storage of properties in an array is specified in section 2.1.1.2.5.

source_rows.heading: Property Values
source_rows.text: Property values are persisted in up to three groups. In the first group, all property values that are less than or equal to 4 bytes in size are stored in the order in which they are referenced by the property mask. This group is the DataBlock of the control. Property values that are greater than 4 bytes in size, but are not font or picture properties, are stored in the order in which they are referenced by the property mask. This group is the ExtraDataBlock of the control. Picture properties are stored in the order in which they are referenced by the property mask. This group is the StreamData of the control. Font properties are stored either in the StreamData or following it, as specified per control in section 2.2.

source_rows.heading: Other Data
source_rows.text: Some controls have other data stored after the property values. The other data, if present, can include the TextProps structure or other control-specific data. They are specified in section 2.2 as part of the structure of each control.

source_rows.heading: Padding and Alignment
source_rows.text: Property values stored in the DataBlock portion of a control MUST be stored on alignment boundaries equal to the size of the property value, relative to the beginning of the control in the stream. All 4-byte property values MUST be stored beginning at an offset into the stream, from the beginning of the version number, that is divisible by 4. All 2-byte property values MUST be stored at an offset into the stream, from the beginning of the version number, that is divisible by 2. Extra bytes MUST be added to the stream before any property value that would otherwise be stored starting at an unaligned offset. The value of each of these bytes is undefined, and the bytes MUST be ignored. Padding MUST NOT be added before a property value that is not stored.

source_rows.heading: Padding and Alignment
source_rows.text: After all property values that are less than or equal to 4 bytes in size have been persisted to the stream, extra bytes MUST be added so that the total size, in bytes, of all persisted property values and padding is divisible by 4. The value of these extra bytes at the end of the DataBlock MUST be set to zero, and the bytes MUST be ignored.

source_rows.heading: Padding and Alignment
source_rows.text: Property values that are strings are padded to a length that is divisible by 4, as specified in section 2.4.14. Strings that are stored as part of a property of another type are not padded.

source_rows.heading: Arrays of Property Values
source_rows.text: The TabStrip control stores multiple values for properties that can have a different value for each tab. These values are persisted sequentially, as an array. Arrays MUST be ordered, with the first element in each array corresponding to the first item in the control.

source_rows.heading: Arrays of Property Values
source_rows.text: If all items in the control have the file format default for a property, the array for that property MUST NOT be stored. All arrays that are stored MUST have an entry for each item, including items that have the file format default.

source_rows.heading: Persistence to a Storage
source_rows.text: If a client application requests that a non-parent control be persisted to a storage, a stream is created in the storage provided by the client. The stream name MUST be named "contents". The control is then persisted to that stream as specified in section 2.1.1.2. A CompObj stream is also created in the storage provided by the client.

source_rows.heading: Control Streams
source_rows.text: This section specifies the format of embedded controls and controls that can contain embedded controls.

source_rows.heading: Parent Controls
source_rows.text: A parent control, that is, a control that can contain embedded controls, MUST be persisted as a storage that contains multiple streams. The name of the storage and its location in the file are specified by the client application that provides the storage. The streams are specified in the following sections.

source_rows.heading: Form Stream
source_rows.text: All parent controls MUST contain a FormControl. The FormControl properties are persisted to a stream as specified in section 2.1.1.2. The name of this stream MUST be "f". An OleSiteConcrete is persisted in this stream for each embedded control, as specified by the FormControl in section 2.2.10.12. The FormControl can also contain a DesignExtender, as specified in section 2.2.10.11.

source_rows.heading: Object Stream
source_rows.text: Embedded controls that cannot themselves contain other embedded controls are persisted sequentially as FormEmbeddedActiveXControls to a stream contained in the same storage as the parent control. The name of this stream MUST be "o". The order in which they are persisted is specified by the order of SiteData.Sites in the FormControl of the parent, as specified in section 2.2.10.6. If a parent control contains no embedded controls or only embedded controls that are also parent controls, this stream MUST still exist and MUST be empty.

source_rows.heading: Embedded Parents
source_rows.text: Embedded controls that can contain other embedded controls are each persisted to a separate storage within the same storage as the parent control. The name of this storage MUST be "in", where n is the value of the ID property of the control. The value of ID is specified by the parent control. The value of n is the decimal representation of ID. Values of ID less than 10 MUST be preceded by a leading zero when used as part of the storage name. Values of ID greater than 10 MUST NOT be preceded by a leading zero.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control Structure
source_rows.text: A MultiPage control that is persisted in a binary format uses the storage and streams specified in section 2.1.2.1 and section 2.1.2.2. It consists of a FormControl, which is stored in the Form stream, a TabStripControl, which is stored in the Object stream, and multiple Page controls, which are stored as specified in section 2.1.2.2.2.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control Structure
source_rows.text: The storage of a MultiPage control also contains an additional stream, which MUST be named "x". This stream contains an array of PageProperties immediately followed by a MultiPageProperties. The number of elements in the array of PageProperties MUST be set to 1 plus the value of DataBlock.PageCount of the MultiPageProperties. The first PageProperties in the array MUST be ignored. The remaining elements specify one PageProperties for each Page in the control. The order of the Pages is specified by the value of the ExtraDataBlock.Items of the TabStripControl specified in the previous paragraph.

source_rows.heading: Page Control Structure
source_rows.text: A Page MUST be stored as part of a MultiPage control. A Page that is persisted in a binary format uses the storage and streams specified in section 2.1.2.1 and section 2.1.2.2.2. It consists of a FormControl, which is stored in the Form stream, optional embedded controls in the Object stream, and a PageProperties, which is stored in the "x" stream of its parent control, as specified in section 2.1.2.3.

source_rows.heading: CompObj Stream
source_rows.text: The stream name MUST be "\001CompObj", where \001 is the character with a value 0x0001, not the string literal "\001". The contents of this stream are specified by [MS-OLEDS].

source_rows.heading: Control Structures
source_rows.text: This section contains specifications of the structure of each control.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonControl
source_rows.text: Specifies the structure of the control as persisted to a stream.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonControl
source_rows.text: MinorVersion (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the minor version of the control. MUST be set to 0x00.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonControl
source_rows.text: MajorVersion (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the major version of the control. MUST be set to 0x02.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonControl
source_rows.text: cbCommandButton (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of PropMask, DataBlock, and ExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonControl
source_rows.text: PropMask (4 bytes): A CommandButtonPropMask that specifies which properties of the control are not set to the file format default.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonControl
source_rows.text: DataBlock (variable): A CommandButtonDataBlock that specifies the properties of the control that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonControl
source_rows.text: ExtraDataBlock (variable): A CommandButtonExtraDataBlock that specifies the properties of the control that are larger than 4 bytes and are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonControl
source_rows.text: StreamData (variable): A CommandButtonStreamData that specifies picture properties of the control that are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonControl
source_rows.text: TextProps (variable): A TextProps that specifies text-related properties of the control.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonPropMask
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the control that are not set to the file format default. For each bit, a value of zero specifies that the corresponding property is the file format default and is not stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonPropMask
source_rows.text: A - fForeColor (1 bit): Specifies whether the ForeColor property is stored in the DataBlock.ForeColor of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonPropMask.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonPropMask
source_rows.text: B - fBackColor (1 bit): Specifies whether the BackColor property is stored in the DataBlock.BackColor of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonPropMask.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonPropMask
source_rows.text: C - fVariousPropertyBits (1 bit): Specifies whether the VariousPropertyBits property is stored in the DataBlock.VariousPropertyBits of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonPropMask.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonPropMask
source_rows.text: D - fCaption (1 bit): Specifies whether the size and compression flag of the Caption property are stored in the DataBlock.Caption of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonPropMask and the Caption string is stored in the ExtraDataBlock.Caption of the CommandButtonControl.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonPropMask
source_rows.text: E - fPicturePosition (1 bit): Specifies whether the PicturePosition property is stored in the DataBlock.PicturePosition of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonPropMask.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonPropMask
source_rows.text: F - fSize (1 bit): Specifies whether the Size property is stored in the ExtraDataBlock.Size of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonPropMask. MUST be set to 1.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonPropMask
source_rows.text: G - fMousePointer (1 bit): Specifies whether the MousePointer property is stored in the DataBlock.MousePointer of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonPropMask.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonPropMask
source_rows.text: H - fPicture (1 bit): Specifies whether the Picture property is stored in the StreamData.Picture of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonPropMask. When this bit is set to 1, a value of 0xFFFF MUST be stored in the DataBlock.Picture of the CommandButtonControl.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonPropMask
source_rows.text: I - fAccelerator (1 bit): Specifies whether the Accelerator property is stored in the DataBlock.Accelerator of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonPropMask.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonPropMask
source_rows.text: J - fTakeFocusOnClick (1 bit): Specifies whether the value of the TakeFocusOnClick property is not the file format default.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonPropMask
source_rows.text: K - fMouseIcon (1 bit): Specifies whether the MouseIcon property is stored in the StreamData.MouseIcon of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonPropMask. When this bit is set to 1, a value of 0xFFFF MUST be stored in the DataBlock.MouseIcon of the CommandButtonControl.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonPropMask
source_rows.text: UnusedBits (21 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonDataBlock
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the control that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not set to the file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonDataBlock is set to zero, the property value MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonDataBlock
source_rows.text: ForeColor (4 bytes): An OLE_COLOR that specifies the value of the ForeColor property.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonDataBlock
source_rows.text: BackColor (4 bytes): An OLE_COLOR that specifies the value of the BackColor property.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonDataBlock
source_rows.text: VariousPropertyBits (4 bytes): A VariousPropertiesBitfield that specifies the value of the VariousPropertyBits properties.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonDataBlock
source_rows.text: Caption (4 bytes): A CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag that specifies the size and compression of the Caption property.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonDataBlock
source_rows.text: PicturePosition (4 bytes): An fmPicturePosition that specifies the value of the PicturePosition property.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonDataBlock
source_rows.text: MousePointer (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the value of the MousePointer property.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding1 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonDataBlock
source_rows.text: Picture (2 bytes): MUST be set to 0xFFFF when the PropMask.fPicture of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonDataBlock is set to 1. Not present when PropMask.fPicture is set to zero.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding2 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes needed to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonDataBlock
source_rows.text: Accelerator (2 bytes): A Unicode character that specifies the value of the Accelerator property.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding3 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonDataBlock
source_rows.text: MouseIcon (2 bytes): MUST be set to 0xFFFF when PropMask.fMouseIcon of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonDataBlock is set to 1. Not present when PropMask.fMouseIcon is set to zero.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding4 (variable): MUST be set to zero. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to make the total size, in bytes, of this CommandButtonDataBlock divisible by 4.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the control that are larger than 4 bytes and are not set to the file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonExtraDataBlock is set to zero, the property value MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Caption (variable): An fmString that specifies the Caption property. The size and compression of the string is specified by the DataBlock.Caption of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Size (8 bytes): An fmSize that specifies the Size property.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonStreamData
source_rows.text: Specifies picture properties of the control that are not set to the file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the CommandButtonControl that contains this CommandButtonStreamData is set to zero, the property value MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonStreamData
source_rows.text: Picture (variable): A GuidAndPicture that specifies the Picture property.

source_rows.heading: CommandButtonStreamData
source_rows.text: MouseIcon (variable): A GuidAndPicture that specifies the MouseIcon property.

source_rows.heading: Frame Control
source_rows.text: A Frame control is a parent control that is persisted in binary format as specified in section 2.1.2.1.1. In other words, it consists of a FormControl stored in a Form stream, with any child controls stored in an Object stream, as specified in section 2.1.2.2. If the Frame control is the child of another control, it is persisted to a storage as specified in section 2.1.2.2.2, with its child objects persisted to the Object stream within the parent storage.

source_rows.heading: ImageControl
source_rows.text: Specifies the structure of the control as persisted to a stream.

source_rows.heading: ImageControl
source_rows.text: MinorVersion (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the minor version of the control. MUST be set to 0x00.

source_rows.heading: ImageControl
source_rows.text: MajorVersion (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the major version of the control. MUST be set to 0x02.

source_rows.heading: ImageControl
source_rows.text: cbImage (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of PropMask, DataBlock, and ExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: ImageControl
source_rows.text: PropMask (4 bytes): An ImagePropMask that specifies which properties of the control are not set to the file format default.

source_rows.heading: ImageControl
source_rows.text: DataBlock (variable): An ImageDataBlock that specifies the properties of the control that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: ImageControl
source_rows.text: ExtraDataBlock (variable): An ImageExtraDataBlock that specifies the properties of the control that are larger than 4 bytes and are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: ImageControl
source_rows.text: StreamData (variable): An ImageStreamData that specifies picture properties of the control that are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the control that are not set to the file format default. For each bit, a value of zero specifies that the corresponding property is the file format default and is not stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: A - UnusedBits1 (2 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: B - fAutoSize (1 bit): Specifies whether the value of the AutoSize property is not the file format default.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: C - fBorderColor (1 bit): Specifies whether the BorderColor property is stored in the DataBlock.BorderColor of the ImageControl that contains this ImagePropMask.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: D - fBackColor (1 bit): Specifies whether the BackColor property is stored in the DataBlock.BackColor of the ImageControl that contains this ImagePropMask.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: E - fBorderStyle (1 bit): Specifies whether the BorderStyle property is stored in the DataBlock.BorderStyle of the ImageControl that contains this ImagePropMask.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: F - fMousePointer (1 bit): Specifies whether the MousePointer property is stored in the DataBlock.MousePointer of the ImageControl that contains this ImagePropMask.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: G - fPictureSizeMode (1 bit): Specifies whether the PictureSizeMode property is stored in the DataBlock.PictureSizeMode of the ImageControl that contains this ImagePropMask.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: H - fSpecialEffect (1 bit): Specifies whether the SpecialEffect property is stored in the DataBlock.PictureSizeMode of the ImageControl that contains this ImagePropMask.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: I - fSize (1 bit): Specifies whether the Size property is stored in the ExtraDataBlock.Size of the ImageControl that contains this ImagePropMask. MUST be set to 1.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: J - fPicture (1 bit): Specifies whether the Picture property is stored in the StreamData.Picture of the ImageControl that contains this ImagePropMask. When this bit is set to 1, a value of 0xFFFF MUST be stored in the DataBlock.Picture of the ImageControl.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: K - fPictureAlignment (1 bit): Specifies whether the PictureAlignment property is stored in the DataBlock.PictureAlignment of the ImageControl that contains this ImagePropMask.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: L - fPictureTiling (1 bit): Specifies whether the value of the PictureTiling property is the file format default.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: M - fVariousPropertyBits (1 bit): Specifies whether the VariousPropertyBits property is stored in the DataBlock.VariousPropertyBits of the ImageControl that contains this ImagePropMask.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: N - fMouseIcon (1 bit): Specifies whether the MouseIcon property is stored in the StreamData.MouseIcon of the ImageControl that contains this ImagePropMask. When this bit is set to 1, a value of 0xFFFF MUST be stored in the DataBlock.MouseIcon of the ImageControl.

source_rows.heading: ImagePropMask
source_rows.text: UnusedBits2 (17 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: ImageDataBlock
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the control that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not set to the file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the ImageControl that contains this ImageDataBlock is set to zero, the property value MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: ImageDataBlock
source_rows.text: BorderColor (4 bytes): An OLE_COLOR that specifies the value of the BorderColor property.

source_rows.heading: ImageDataBlock
source_rows.text: BackColor (4 bytes): An OLE_COLOR that specifies the value of the BackColor property.

source_rows.heading: ImageDataBlock
source_rows.text: BorderStyle (1 byte): An fmBorderStyle that specifies the value of the BorderStyle property.

source_rows.heading: ImageDataBlock
source_rows.text: MousePointer (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the value of the MousePointer property.

source_rows.heading: ImageDataBlock
source_rows.text: PictureSizeMode (1 byte): An fmPictureSizeMode that specifies the value of the PictureSizeMode property.

source_rows.heading: ImageDataBlock
source_rows.text: SpecialEffect (1 byte): An fmSpecialEffect that specifies the value of the SpecialEffect property.

source_rows.heading: ImageDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding1 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: ImageDataBlock
source_rows.text: Picture (2 bytes): MUST be set to 0xFFFF when PropMask.fPicture of the ImageControl that contains this ImageDataBlock is set to 1. Not present when PropMask.fPicture is set to zero.

source_rows.heading: ImageDataBlock
source_rows.text: PictureAlignment (1 byte): An fmPictureAlignment that specifies the value of the PictureAlignment property.

source_rows.heading: ImageDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding2 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: ImageDataBlock
source_rows.text: VariousPropertyBits (4 bytes): A VariousPropertiesBitfield that specifies the value of the VariousPropertyBits properties.

source_rows.heading: ImageDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding3 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: ImageDataBlock
source_rows.text: MouseIcon (2 bytes): MUST be set to 0xFFFF when the PropMask.fMouseIcon of the ImageControl that contains this ImageDataBlock is set to 1. Not present when PropMask.fMouseIcon is set to zero.

source_rows.heading: ImageDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding4 (variable): MUST be set to zero. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to make the total size, in bytes, of this ImageDataBlock divisible by 4.

source_rows.heading: ImageExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the control that are larger than 4 bytes and are not set to the file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the ImageControl that contains this ImageExtraDataBlock is set to zero, the property value MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: ImageExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Size (8 bytes): An fmSize that specifies the Size property.

source_rows.heading: ImageStreamData
source_rows.text: Specifies picture properties of the control that are not set to the file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the ImageControl that contains this ImageStreamData is set to zero, the property value MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: ImageStreamData
source_rows.text: Picture (variable): A GuidAndPicture that specifies the Picture property.

source_rows.heading: ImageStreamData
source_rows.text: MouseIcon (variable): A GuidAndPicture that specifies the MouseIcon property.

source_rows.heading: LabelControl
source_rows.text: Specifies the structure of the control as persisted to a stream.

source_rows.heading: LabelControl
source_rows.text: MinorVersion (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the minor version of the control. MUST be set to 0x00.

source_rows.heading: LabelControl
source_rows.text: MajorVersion (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the major version of the control. MUST be set to 0x02.

source_rows.heading: LabelControl
source_rows.text: cbLabel (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of PropMask, DataBlock, and ExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: LabelControl
source_rows.text: PropMask (4 bytes): A LabelPropMask that specifies which properties of the control are not set to the file format default.

source_rows.heading: LabelControl
source_rows.text: DataBlock (variable): A LabelDataBlock that specifies the properties of the control that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: LabelControl
source_rows.text: ExtraDataBlock (variable): A LabelExtraDataBlock that specifies the properties of the control that are larger than 4 bytes and are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: LabelControl
source_rows.text: StreamData (variable): A LabelStreamData that specifies picture properties of the control that are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: LabelControl
source_rows.text: TextProps (variable): A TextProps that specifies text-related properties of the control.

source_rows.heading: MorphData Control Structure
source_rows.text: The MorphDataControl structure is an aggregate of six controls: CheckBox, ComboBox, ListBox, OptionButton, TextBox, and ToggleButton. The type of the control is specified by the DisplayStyle property. This section specifies the persistence format for all six controls.

source_rows.heading: MorphDataControl
source_rows.text: Specifies the structure of the control as persisted to a stream.

source_rows.heading: MorphDataControl

source_rows.heading: MorphDataControl
source_rows.text: cbMorphData (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of PropMask, DataBlock, and ExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.text: PropMask (8 bytes): A MorphDataPropMask that specifies which properties of the control are not set to the file format default.

source_rows.heading: MorphDataControl
source_rows.text: rgColumnInfo (variable): Optional. An array of MorphDataColumnInfo. Specifies the width of columns in ComboBox and ListBox controls. MUST NOT exist for other types of controls. The number of elements in this array MUST be equal to the value of the cColumnInfo property.

source_rows.heading: TabStripExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the control that are larger than 4 bytes and are not set to the file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the TabStripControl that contains this TabStripExtraDataBlock is set to zero, the property value MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: TabStripExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Properties that can have a different value for each tab MUST be stored if at least one tab has a non-default value for the property. The property values are persisted as arrays, as specified in section 2.1.1.2.5.

source_rows.heading: TabStripExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: The order of elements in Items specifies the order of the tabs in this control. The other property arrays MUST use the same order if they are stored.

source_rows.heading: TabStripExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Size (8 bytes): An fmSize that specifies the value of the Size property.

source_rows.heading: TabStripExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Items (variable): An array of ArrayString. Specifies the value of the Caption property for each tab in the TabStripControl that contains this TabStripExtraDataBlock. The first element in the array corresponds to the first tab, and so on. The size, in bytes, of this array MUST be equal to the value of the DataBlock.ItemsSize in the TabStripControl that contains this TabStripExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: TabStripExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: TipStrings (variable): An array of ArrayString. Specifies the value of the Tooltip property for each tab in the TabStripControl that contains this TabStripExtraDataBlock. The first element in the array corresponds to the first tab, and so on. The size, in bytes, of this array MUST be equal to the value of the DataBlock.TipStringsSize in the TabStripControl that contains this TabStripExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: TabStripExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: TabNames (variable): An array of ArrayString. Specifies the value of the Name property for each tab in the TabStripControl that contains this TabStripExtraDataBlock. The first element in the array corresponds to the first tab, and so on. The size, in bytes, of this array MUST be equal to the value of the DataBlock.NamesSize in the TabStripControl that contains this TabStripExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: TabStripExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Tags (variable): An array of ArrayString. Specifies the value of the Tag property for each tab in the TabStripControl that contains this TabStripExtraDataBlock. The first element in the array corresponds to the first tab, and so on. The size, in bytes, of this array MUST be equal to the value of the DataBlock.TagsSize in the TabStripControl that contains this TabStripExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: TabStripExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Accelerators (variable): An array of ArrayString. Specifies the value of the Accelerator property for each tab in the TabStripControl that contains this TabStripExtraDataBlock. The first element in the array corresponds to the first tab, and so on. The size, in bytes, of this array MUST be equal to the value of the DataBlock.AcceleratorsSize in the TabStripControl that contains this TabStripExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: TabStripStreamData
source_rows.text: Specifies picture properties of the control that are not set to their file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the TabStripControl that contains this TabStripStreamData is set to zero, the property value MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: TabStripStreamData
source_rows.text: MouseIcon (variable): A GuidAndPicture that specifies the MouseIcon property.

source_rows.heading: TabStripTabFlagData
source_rows.text: Specifies properties for individual tabs in the TabStripControl that contains this TabStripTabFlagData. If PropMask.fTabData is set to zero, these properties MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: TabStripTabFlagData
source_rows.text: Arrays in this structure are ordered. The first element in each array corresponds to the first tab. The order of elements in ExtraDataBlock.Items specifies the order of the tabs.

source_rows.heading: TabStripTabFlagData
source_rows.text: TabStripTabFlags (variable): An array of TabStripTabFlag. Specifies Boolean properties of each tab. The number of elements in this array MUST be equal to the value of the DataBlock.TabData of the TabStripControl that contains this TabStripTabFlagData.

source_rows.heading: TabStripTabFlag
source_rows.text: Specifies whether a tab is visible and whether it is enabled.

source_rows.heading: TabStripTabFlag
source_rows.text: A - fTabVisible (1 bit): Specifies whether the tab is visible.

source_rows.heading: TabStripTabFlag
source_rows.text: B - fTabEnabled (1 bit): Specifies whether the tab is enabled.

source_rows.heading: TabStripTabFlag
source_rows.text: Unused (30 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: UserForm Structure
source_rows.text: Forms are parent controls. They are persisted in binary format as specified in section 2.1.2. This section specifies the format of the Form stream.

source_rows.heading: FormControl
source_rows.text: Specifies the structure of the control as persisted to a stream.

source_rows.heading: FormControl
source_rows.text: MinorVersion (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the minor version of the control. MUST be set to 0x00.

source_rows.heading: FormControl
source_rows.text: MajorVersion (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the major version of the control. MUST be set to 0x04.

source_rows.heading: FormControl
source_rows.text: cbForm (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of PropMask, DataBlock and ExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: FormControl
source_rows.text: PropMask (4 bytes): A FormPropMask that specifies which properties of the control are not set to the file format default.

source_rows.heading: FormControl
source_rows.text: DataBlock (variable): A FormDataBlock that specifies the properties of the control that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: FormControl
source_rows.text: ExtraDataBlock (variable): A FormExtraDataBlock that specifies the properties of the control that are larger than 4 bytes and are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: FormControl
source_rows.text: StreamData (variable): A FormStreamData that specifies font and picture properties of the control that are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: FormControl
source_rows.text: SiteData (variable): A FormSiteData that specifies properties of the embedded controls of a form.

source_rows.heading: FormControl
source_rows.text: DesignExData (variable): A FormDesignExData that specifies properties of the design surface of the form.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the control that are not set to the file format default. For each bit, a value of zero specifies that the corresponding property is the file format default and is not stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: A - Unused1 (1 bit): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: B - fBackColor (1 bit): Specifies whether the BackColor property is stored in the DataBlock.BackColor of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: C - fForeColor (1 bit): Specifies whether the ForeColor property is stored in the DataBlock.ForeColor of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: D - fNextAvailableID (1 bit): Specifies whether the NextAvailableID property is stored in the DataBlock.NextAvailableID of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: E - Unused2 (2 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: F - fBooleanProperties (1 bit): Specifies whether the BooleanProperties property is stored in the DataBlock.BooleanProperties of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: G - fBorderStyle (1 bit): Specifies whether the BorderStyle property is stored in the DataBlock.BorderStyle of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: H - fMousePointer (1 bit): Specifies whether the MousePointer property is stored in the DataBlock.MousePointer of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: I - fScrollBars (1 bit): Specifies whether the ScrollBars property is stored in the DataBlock.ScrollBars of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: J - fDisplayedSize (1 bit): Specifies whether the DisplayedSize property is stored in the ExtraDataBlock.DisplayedSize of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: K - fLogicalSize (1 bit): Specifies whether the LogicalSize property is stored in the ExtraDataBlock.LogicalSize of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: L - fScrollPosition (1 bit): Specifies whether the ScrollPosition property is stored in the ExtraDataBlock.ScrollPosition of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: M - fGroupCnt (1 bit): Specifies whether the GroupCount property is stored in the DataBlock.GroupCnt of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: N - Reserved (1 bit): MUST be set to zero and MUST be ignored.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: O - fMouseIcon (1 bit): Specifies whether the MouseIcon property is stored in the StreamData.MouseIcon of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask. When this bit is set to 1, a value of 0xFFFF MUST be stored in the DataBlock.MouseIcon of the FormControl.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: P - fCycle (1 bit): Specifies whether the Cycle property is stored in the DataBlock.Cycle of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: Q - fSpecialEffect (1 bit): Specifies whether the SpecialEffect property is stored in the DataBlock.SpecialEffect of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: R - fBorderColor (1 bit): Specifies whether the BorderColor property is stored in the DataBlock.BorderColor of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: S - fCaption (1 bit): Specifies whether the size and compression flag of the Caption property are stored in the DataBlock.LengthAndCompression of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask and the Caption string is stored in the ExtraDataBlock.Caption of the FormControl.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: T - fFont (1 bit): Specifies whether the Font property is stored in the StreamData.GuidAndFont of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: U - fPicture (1 bit): Specifies whether the Picture property is stored in the StreamData.Picture of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: V - fZoom (1 bit): Specifies whether the Zoom property is stored in the DataBlock.Zoom of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: W - fPictureAlignment (1 bit): Specifies whether the PictureAlignment property is stored in the DataBlock.PictureAlignment of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: X - fPictureTiling (1 bit): Specifies whether the value of the PictureTiling property is not the file format default.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: Y - fPictureSizeMode (1 bit): Specifies whether the PictureSizeMode property is stored in the DataBlock.PictureSizeMode of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: Z - fShapeCookie (1 bit): Specifies whether the ShapeCookie property is stored in the DataBlock.ShapeCookie of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: a - fDrawBuffer (1 bit): Specifies whether the DrawBuffer property is stored in the DataBlock.DrawBuffer of the FormControl that contains this FormPropMask. MUST be set to 1.

source_rows.heading: FormPropMask
source_rows.text: Unused3 (4 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the Form that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not set to the file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the FormControl that contains this FormDataBlock is set to zero, the property value MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.text: BackColor (4 bytes): An OLE_COLOR that specifies the value of the BackColor property.

source_rows.text: ForeColor (4 bytes): An OLE_COLOR that specifies the value of the ForeColor property.

source_rows.text: ScrollBars (1 byte): A FormScrollBarFlags that specifies the value of the ScrollBars property.

source_rows.text: GroupCnt (4 bytes): A signed integer that specifies the value of the GroupCount property.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding2 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: MouseIcon (2 bytes): MUST be set to 0xFFFF when the PropMask.fMouseIcon of the FormControl that contains this FormDataBlock is set to 1. Not present when PropMask.fMouseIcon is set to zero.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: Cycle (1 byte): An fmCycle that specifies the value of the Cycle property.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: SpecialEffect (1 byte): An fmSpecialEffect that specifies the value of the SpecialEffect property.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding3 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: BorderColor (4 bytes): An OLE_COLOR that specifies the value of the BorderColor property.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding4 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: LengthAndCompression (4 bytes): A CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag that specifies the size and compression of the Caption property.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding5 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: Font (2 bytes): MUST be set to 0xFFFF when the PropMask.fFont of the FormControl that contains this FormDataBlock is set to 1. Not present when PropMask.fFont is set to zero.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding6 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: Picture (2 bytes): MUST be set to 0xFFFF when the PropMask.fPicture of the FormControl that contains this FormDataBlock is set to 1. Not present when PropMask.fPicture is set to zero.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding7 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: Zoom (4 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the value of the Zoom property.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: PictureAlignment (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the value of the PictureAlignment property.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: PictureSizeMode (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the value of the PictureSizeMode property.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding8 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: ShapeCookie (4 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the value of the ShapeCookie property.

source_rows.heading: FormDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding9 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.text: DrawBuffer (4 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the value of the DrawBuffer property.

source_rows.heading: FormStreamData

source_rows.text: MouseIcon (variable): A GuidAndPicture that specifies the MouseIcon property.

source_rows.text: GuidAndFont (variable): A GuidAndFont that specifies the Font property.

source_rows.heading: FormStreamData
source_rows.text: Picture (variable): A GuidAndPicture that specifies the Picture property.

source_rows.heading: FormSiteData
source_rows.text: The depth, specified in section 2.2.10.7, SITE_TYPE and properties of each embedded control in the FormControl that contains this FormSiteData.

source_rows.heading: FormSiteData
