source_rows.text: CountOfSiteClassInfo (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the number of elements in ClassTable. This field MUST NOT be stored if the value of DataBlock.BooleanProperties.FORM_FLAG_DONTSAVECLASSTABLE in the FormControl that contains this FormSiteData is set to 1.

source_rows.heading: FormSiteData
source_rows.text: ClassTable (variable): An array of SiteClassInfo structures. Specifies class information of controls that are not one of the types specified by FormEmbeddedActiveXControlCached. If CountOfSiteClassInfo is set to zero or not stored, this field MUST NOT be stored.

source_rows.heading: FormSiteData
source_rows.text: CountOfSites (4 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the number of elements in Sites.

source_rows.heading: FormSiteData
source_rows.text: CountOfBytes (4 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of SiteDepthsAndTypes, ArrayPadding, and Sites.

source_rows.heading: FormSiteData
source_rows.text: SiteDepthsAndTypes (variable): An array of FormObjectDepthTypeCount. Specifies the depth as specified in section 2.2.10.7 and SITE_TYPE of each control in Sites. The order of this array MUST be the same as the order of Sites, but one element in this array can specify more than one consecutive element in Sites. If the fCount of an element in this array is set to 1, TypeOrCount specifies the number of consecutive elements in Sites represented by that element in this array. The sum of the number of elements in this array in which fCount is set to zero and the TypeOrCount of each element in this array in which fCount is set to 1 MUST equal CountOfSites.

source_rows.heading: FormSiteData
source_rows.text: ArrayPadding (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes that, when added to the size, in bytes, of SiteDepthsAndTypes, produces a sum divisible by 4.

source_rows.heading: FormSiteData
source_rows.text: Sites (variable): An array of OleSiteConcreteControl. Specifies properties of each embedded control in the FormControl that contains this FormSiteData.

source_rows.heading: FormObjectDepthTypeCount
source_rows.text: Specifies the depth and SITE_TYPE of an embedded control. Optionally specifies a count of consecutive controls that have the same depth and SITE_TYPE.

source_rows.heading: FormObjectDepthTypeCount
source_rows.text: Depth (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the depth of an embedded control, that is, how many controls exist in the hierarchy between the embedded control and the parent control.

source_rows.heading: FormObjectDepthTypeCount
source_rows.text: TypeOrCount (7 bits): An unsigned integer. If fCount is set to zero, this field specifies the SITE_TYPE of an embedded control. If fCount is set to 1, this field specifies the number of consecutive embedded controls of the same depth and SITE_TYPE.

source_rows.heading: FormObjectDepthTypeCount
source_rows.text: A - fCount (1 bit): Specifies whether TypeOrCount is a count of consecutive embedded controls.

source_rows.heading: FormObjectDepthTypeCount
source_rows.text: OptionalType (1 byte): Specifies the SITE_TYPE of TypeOrCount consecutive embedded controls when fCount is set to 1. If fCount is set to zero, this field MUST NOT be stored.

source_rows.heading: SITE_TYPE
source_rows.text: Specifies the type of an embedded control. MUST be set to 1.

source_rows.heading: FormDesignExData
source_rows.text: Specifies design-time properties of a form.

source_rows.heading: FormDesignExData
source_rows.text: DesignEx (variable): A DesignExtender that specifies the properties of the design surface of this form. If the value of DataBlock.BooleanProperties.FORM_FLAG_DESINKPERSISTED of the FormControl that contains this FormDesignExData is set to zero, this structure MUST NOT be stored.

source_rows.heading: ClassTable Structure
source_rows.text: This structure specifies the type information of a ControlNonCached in a FormEmbeddedActiveXControl. The control MUST be able to interact through OLE Automation, as specified in [MS-OAUT].

source_rows.heading: SiteClassInfo
source_rows.text: Specifies the structure, as persisted to a stream, of the type information of an embedded ActiveX control.

source_rows.heading: SiteClassInfo
source_rows.text: Version (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the version of this SiteClassInfo. MUST be set to 0x0000.

source_rows.heading: SiteClassInfo
source_rows.text: cbClassTable (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of PropMask, DataBlock, and ExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: SiteClassInfo
source_rows.text: PropMask (4 bytes): A ClassInfoPropMask that specifies which properties of this SiteClassInfo are not set to the file format default.

source_rows.heading: SiteClassInfo
source_rows.text: DataBlock (variable): A ClassInfoDataBlock that specifies the properties of this SiteClassInfo that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: SiteClassInfo
source_rows.text: ExtraDataBlock (variable): A ClassInfoExtraDataBlock that specifies the properties of this SiteClassInfo that are larger than 4 bytes and are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoPropMask that are not set to the file format default. For each bit, a value of zero specifies that the corresponding property is the file format default and is not stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: A - fClsID (1 bit): Specifies whether ExtraDataBlock.ClsID is stored in the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoPropMask.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: B - fDispEvent (1 bit): Specifies whether ExtraDataBlock.DispEvent is stored in the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoPropMask.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: C - Unused1 (1 bit): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: D - fDefaultProg (1 bit): Specifies whether ExtraDataBlock.DefaultProg is stored in the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoPropMask.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: E - fClassFlags (1 bit): Specifies whether DataBlock.ClassTableFlags and DataBlock.VarFlags are stored in the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoPropMask.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: F - fCountOfMethods (1 bit): Specifies whether DataBlock.CountOfMethods is stored in the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoPropMask.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: G - fDispidBind (1 bit): Specifies whether DataBlock.DispidBind is stored in the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoPropMask.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: H - fGetBindIndex (1 bit): Specifies whether DataBlock.GetBindIndex is stored in the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoPropMask.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: I - fPutBindIndex (1 bit): Specifies whether DataBlock.PutBindIndex is stored in the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoPropMask.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: J - fBindType (1 bit): Specifies whether DataBlock.BindType is stored in the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoPropMask.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: K - fGetValueIndex (1 bit): Specifies whether DataBlock.GetValueIndex is stored in the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoPropMask.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: L - fPutValueIndex (1 bit): Specifies whether DataBlock.PutValueIndex is stored in the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoPropMask.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: M - fValueType (1 bit): Specifies whether DataBlock.ValueType is stored in the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoPropMask.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: N - fDispidRowset (1 bit): Specifies whether DataBlock.DispidRowset is stored in the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoPropMask.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: O - fSetRowset (1 bit): Specifies whether DataBlock.SetRowset is stored in the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoPropMask.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoPropMask
source_rows.text: Unused2 (17 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the type information of the embedded control that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not set to the file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoDataBlock is set to zero, the field MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: ClassTableFlags (2 bytes): A CLSTABLE_FLAGS that specifies Boolean properties of the type information.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: VarFlags (2 bytes): A VARFLAGS, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.18, that specifies Boolean properties of the type information.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: CountOfMethods (4 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the number of methods on the default dual interface of the type information.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: DispidBind (4 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the IDispatch identifier (DispID) of the default bindable property, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.49.5.2, in this type information. The value of this field is the memid field of the VARDESC of the function, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.43. The VARDESC.wVarFlags field MUST be set to 0x00000014, or FUNCFLAG_FBINDABLE and FUNCFLAG_FDISPLAYBIND, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.11.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0xFFFFFFFF, DISPID_UNKNOWN.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: GetBindIndex (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the index of the "get" function of the default bindable property, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.49.5.2, into the dynamic virtual table of a type information that implements a dual interface. The value of this field is the oVft field of the FUNCDESC that specifies the function, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.42. The memid field of this FUNCDESC MUST NOT be set to DISPID_VALUE, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.32.1. The invkind field of this FUNCDESC MUST be set to INVOKE_PROPERTYGET, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.14.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: PutBindIndex (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the index of the "put" function of the default bindable property, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.49.5.2, into the dynamic virtual table of a type information that implements a dual interface. The value of this field is the oVft field of the FUNCDESC that specifies the function, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.42. The memid field of this FUNCDESC MUST NOT be set to DISPID_VALUE, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.32.1. The invkind field of this FUNCDESC MUST be set to INVOKE_PROPERTYPUT, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.14.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: BindType (2 bytes): A variant type that specifies the type of the default bindable property, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.49.5.2. The value of this field is the vt field of the TYPEDESC, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.37, of the FUNCDESC.elemdescFunc, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.42, of the function referenced by GetBindIndex or PutBindIndex in this ClassInfoDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x0000, VT_EMPTY.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: GetValueIndex (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the index of the function that retrieves the value of the control into the dynamic virtual table of the class. The value of this field is the oVft field of the FUNCDESC that specifies the function, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.42. The memid of the FUNCDESC MUST be set to DISPID_VALUE, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.32.1. The invkind field of the FUNCDESC MUST be set to INVOKE_PROPERTYGET, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.14.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: PutValueIndex (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the index of the function that sets the value of the control into the dynamic virtual table of the class. The value of this field is the oVft field of the FUNCDESC that specifies the function, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.42. The memid of the FUNCDESC MUST be set to DISPID_VALUE, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.32.1. The invkind field of the FUNCDESC MUST be set to INVOKE_PROPERTYPUT, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.14.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: ValueType (2 bytes): A variant type that specifies the type of the value that is returned in response to DISPID_VALUE. The value of this field is the vt field of the TYPEDESC, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.37, of the FUNCDESC.elemdescFunc, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.42, of the function referenced by GetValueIndex or PutValueIndex in this ClassInfoDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x0000, VT_EMPTY.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding1 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes needed to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: DispidRowset (4 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the DispID of a property that supports a method for fetching rows sequentially, getting the data from those rows, and managing rows. The value of this field is the memid field of the FUNCDESC that specifies the property "set" method, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.42, or of the VARDESC that specifies the property, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.43. The value of memid can be determined by the algorithm specified in section 2.6.1.1.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0xFFFFFFFF, DISPID_UNKNOWN.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: SetRowset (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the index of the "set" function into the dynamic virtual table of the class, for a property that supports a method for fetching rows sequentially, getting the data from those rows, and managing rows. The value of this field is the oVft field of the FUNCDESC that specifies the property "set" method, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.42. The value of oVft can be determined by the algorithm specified in section 2.6.1.2.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding2 (variable): MUST be set to zero. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to make the total size, in bytes, of this ClassInfoDataBlock divisible by 4.

source_rows.heading: CLSTABLE_FLAGS
source_rows.text: A bit field that specifies Boolean properties of a SiteClassInfo.

source_rows.heading: CLSTABLE_FLAGS
source_rows.text: A - fExclusiveValue (1 bit): Specifies whether the typeKind member of the TYPEATTR that describes this type information, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.44, is set to TKIND_ALIAS, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.17.

source_rows.heading: CLSTABLE_FLAGS
source_rows.text: B - fDualInterface (1 bit): Specifies whether this type information implements a dual interface.

source_rows.heading: CLSTABLE_FLAGS
source_rows.text: C - fNoAggregation (1 bit): Specifies whether this type information supports aggregation. A value of 1 specifies that the control does not support aggregation.

source_rows.heading: CLSTABLE_FLAGS
source_rows.text: Unused (13 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the class that are larger than 4 bytes and are not set to the file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the SiteClassInfo that contains this ClassInfoDataBlock is set to zero, the field MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: ClsID (16 bytes): A GUID, as specified in [MS-DTYP], that specifies the CLSID of a control.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: DispEvent (16 bytes): A GUID, as specified in [MS-DTYP], that specifies the source interface, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.49.8, in this type information.

source_rows.heading: ClassInfoExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: DefaultProg (16 bytes): A GUID, as specified in [MS-DTYP], that specifies the default interface, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.49.8, in this type information.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtender Structure
source_rows.text: The design surface of a UserForm control.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtender
source_rows.text: Specifies design-time properties of a FormControl as persisted to a stream.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtender
source_rows.text: MinorVersion (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the minor version of the control. MUST be set to 0x00.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtender
source_rows.text: MajorVersion (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the major version of the control. MUST be set to 0x02.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtender
source_rows.text: cbDesignExtender (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of PropMask and DataBlock.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtender
source_rows.text: PropMask (4 bytes): A DesignExtenderPropMask that specifies which properties of the control are not set to the file format default.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtender
source_rows.text: DataBlock (variable): A DesignExtenderDataBlock that specifies the properties of the control that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtenderPropMask
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the control are not set to the file format default. For each bit, a value of zero specifies that the corresponding property is the file format default and is not stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtenderPropMask
source_rows.text: A - fBitFlags (1 bit): Specifies whether the BitFlags property is stored in the DataBlock.BitFlags of the DesignExtender that contains this DesignExtenderPropMask.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtenderPropMask
source_rows.text: B - fGridX (1 bit): Specifies whether the GridX property is stored in the DataBlock.GridX of the DesignExtender that contains this DesignExtenderPropMask.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtenderPropMask
source_rows.text: C - fGridY (1 bit): Specifies whether the GridY property is stored in the DataBlock.GridY of the DesignExtender that contains this DesignExtenderPropMask.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtenderPropMask
source_rows.text: D - fClickControlMode (1 bit): Specifies whether the ClickControlMode property is stored in the DataBlock.ClickControlMode of the DesignExtender that contains this DesignExtenderPropMask.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtenderPropMask
source_rows.text: E - fDblClickControlMode (1 bit): Specifies whether the DblClickControlMode property is stored in the DataBlock.DblClickControlMode of the DesignExtender that contains this DesignExtenderPropMask.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtenderPropMask
source_rows.text: Unused (27 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtenderDataBlock
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the control that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not set to the file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the DesignExtender that contains this DesignExtenderDataBlock is set to zero, the property value MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtenderDataBlock
source_rows.text: BitFlags (4 bytes): A DX_MODE that specifies the BitFlags property.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtenderDataBlock
source_rows.text: GridX (4 bytes): A signed integer that specifies the value of the GridX property.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtenderDataBlock
source_rows.text: GridY (4 bytes): A signed integer that specifies the value of the GridY property.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtenderDataBlock
source_rows.text: ClickControlMode (1 byte): An fmClickControlMode that specifies the value of the ClickControlMode property.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtenderDataBlock
source_rows.text: DblClickControlMode (1 byte): An fmDblClickControlMode that specifies the value of the DblClickControlMode property.

source_rows.heading: DesignExtenderDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding (variable): MUST be set to zero. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to make the total size, in bytes, of this DesignExtenderDataBlock divisible by 4.

source_rows.heading: OleSiteConcrete Structure
source_rows.text: Specifies properties stored for each embedded control in a UserForm control.

source_rows.heading: OleSiteConcreteControl
source_rows.text: Specifies properties of embedded controls in a FormControl as persisted to a stream.

source_rows.heading: OleSiteConcreteControl
source_rows.text: Version (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the version of the control. MUST be set to 0x0000.

source_rows.heading: OleSiteConcreteControl
source_rows.text: cbSite (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of PropMask, DataBlock and ExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: OleSiteConcreteControl
source_rows.text: PropMask (4 bytes): A SitePropMask that specifies which properties of the control are not set to the file format default.

source_rows.heading: OleSiteConcreteControl
source_rows.text: DataBlock (variable): A SiteDataBlock that specifies the properties of the control that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: OleSiteConcreteControl
source_rows.text: ExtraDataBlock (variable): A SiteExtraDataBlock that specifies the properties of the control that are larger than 4 bytes and are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the control are not set to the file format default. For each bit, a value of zero specifies that the corresponding property is the file format default and is not stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: A - fName (1 bit): Specifies whether the size and compression flag of the Name property are stored in the DataBlock.NameData of the OleSiteConcreteControl that contains this SitePropMask and the Name string is stored in the ExtraDataBlock.Name of the OleSiteConcreteControl.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: B - fTag (1 bit): Specifies whether the size and compression flag of the Tag property are stored in the DataBlock.TagData of the OleSiteConcreteControl that contains this SitePropMask and the Tag string is stored in the ExtraDataBlock.Tag of the OleSiteConcreteControl.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: C - fID (1 bit): Specifies whether the ID property is stored in the DataBlock.ID of the OleSiteConcreteControl that contains this SitePropMask.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: D - fHelpContextID (1 bit): Specifies whether the HelpContextID property is stored in the DataBlock.HelpContextID of the OleSiteConcreteControl that contains this SitePropMask.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: E - fBitFlags (1 bit): Specifies whether the BitFlags property is stored in the DataBlock.BitFlags of the OleSiteConcreteControl that contains this SitePropMask.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: F - fObjectStreamSize (1 bit): Specifies whether the ObjectStreamSize property is stored in the DataBlock.ObjectStreamSize of the OleSiteConcreteControl that contains this SitePropMask.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: G - fTabIndex (1 bit): Specifies whether the TabIndex property is stored in the DataBlock.TabIndex of the OleSiteConcreteControl that contains this SitePropMask.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: H - fClsidCacheIndex (1 bit): Specifies whether the ClsidCacheIndex property is stored in the DataBlock.ClsidCacheIndex of the OleSiteConcreteControl that contains this SitePropMask.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: I - fPosition (1 bit): Specifies whether the Position property is stored in the ExtraDataBlock.Position of the OleSiteConcreteControl that contains this SitePropMask.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: J - fGroupID (1 bit): Specifies whether the GroupID property is stored in the DataBlock.GroupID of the OleSiteConcreteControl that contains this SitePropMask.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: K - Unused1 (1 bit): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: L - fControlTipText (1 bit): Specifies whether the size and compression flag of the Tooltip property are stored in the DataBlock.ControlTipTextData of the OleSiteConcreteControl that contains this SitePropMask and the Tooltip string is stored in the ExtraDataBlock.ControlTipText of the OleSiteConcreteControl.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: M - fRuntimeLicKey (1 bit): Specifies whether the size and compression flag of the RuntimeLicKey property are stored in the DataBlock.RuntimeLicKeyData of the OleSiteConcreteControl that contains this SitePropMask and the RuntimeLicKey string is stored in the ExtraDataBlock.RuntimeLicKeyData of the OleSiteConcreteControl.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: N - fControlSource (1 bit): Specifies whether the size and compression flag of the ControlSource property are stored in the DataBlock.ControlSourceData of the OleSiteConcreteControl that contains this SitePropMask and the ControlSource string is stored in the ExtraDataBlock.ControlSource of the OleSiteConcreteControl.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: O - fRowSource (1 bit): Specifies whether the size and compression flag of the RowSource property are stored in the DataBlock.RowSourceData of the OleSiteConcreteControl that contains this SitePropMask and the RowSource string is stored in the ExtraDataBlock.RowSource of the OleSiteConcreteControl.

source_rows.heading: SitePropMask
source_rows.text: Unused2 (17 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the control that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not set to the file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the OleSiteConcrete that contains this SiteDataBlock is set to zero, the property value MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: NameData (4 bytes): A CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag that specifies the size and compression of the Name property.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: TagData (4 bytes): A CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag that specifies the size and compression of the Tag property.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: ID (4 bytes): A signed integer that specifies the value of the ID property.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: HelpContextID (4 bytes): A signed integer that specifies the value of the HelpContextID property.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: BitFlags (4 bytes): A SITE_FLAG that specifies the value of the BitFlags property.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: ObjectStreamSize (4 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the value of the ObjectStreamSize property.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: TabIndex (2 bytes): A signed integer that specifies the value of the TabIndex property.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: ClsidCacheIndex (2 bytes): A unsigned integer that specifies the value of the ClsidCacheIndex property.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: GroupID (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the value of the GroupID property.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding1 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: ControlTipTextData (4 bytes): A CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag that specifies the size and compression of the Tooltip property.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding2 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: RuntimeLicKeyData (4 bytes): A CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag that specifies the size and compression of the RuntimeLicKey property.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding3 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: ControlSourceData (4 bytes): A CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag that specifies the size and compression of the ControlSource property.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding4 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: RowSourceData (4 bytes): A CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag that specifies the size and compression of the RowSource property.

source_rows.heading: SiteDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding5 (variable): MUST be set to zero. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to make the total size, in bytes, of this SiteDataBlock divisible by 4.

source_rows.heading: SiteExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Specifies the properties of the control that are larger than 4 bytes and are not set to the file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the OleSiteConcrete that contains this SiteDataBlock is set to zero, the property value MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: SiteExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Name (variable): An fmString that specifies the value of the Name property.

source_rows.heading: SiteExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Tag (variable): An fmString that specifies the value of the Tag property.

source_rows.heading: SiteExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: SitePosition (8 bytes): An fmPosition that specifies the value of the Position property.

source_rows.heading: SiteExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: ControlTipText (variable): An fmString that specifies the value of the Tooltip property.

source_rows.heading: SiteExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: RuntimeLicKey (variable): An fmString that specifies the value of the RuntimeLicKey property.

source_rows.heading: SiteExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: ControlSource (variable): An fmString that specifies the value of the ControlSource property.

source_rows.heading: SiteExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: RowSource (variable): An fmString that specifies the value of the RowSource property.

source_rows.heading: TextProps
source_rows.text: Specifies the values for text-related properties.

source_rows.heading: TextProps
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | CommandButton | Label | ListBox | OptionButton | TabStrip | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: TextProps
source_rows.text: MinorVersion (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the minor version of the control. MUST be set to 0x00.

source_rows.heading: TextProps
source_rows.text: MajorVersion (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the major version of the control. MUST be set to 0x02.

source_rows.heading: TextProps
source_rows.text: cbTextProps (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of PropMask, DataBlock, and ExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: TextProps
source_rows.text: PropMask (4 bytes): A TextPropsPropMask that specifies which text properties of the control are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: TextProps
source_rows.text: DataBlock (variable): A TextPropsDataBlock that specifies the text properties of the control that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: TextProps
source_rows.text: ExtraDataBlock (variable): A TextPropsExtraDataBlock that specifies the text properties of the control that are larger than 4 bytes and are not set to the file format defaults.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsPropMask
source_rows.text: Specifies the text properties of the control are not set to the file format default. For each bit, a value of zero specifies that the corresponding property is the file format default and is not stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsPropMask
source_rows.text: A - fFontName (1 bit): Specifies whether the size and compression flag of the FontName property are stored in the DataBlock.FontName of the TextProps that contains this TextPropsPropMask and the FontName string is stored in the ExtraDataBlock.FontName of the TextProps.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsPropMask
source_rows.text: B - fFontEffects (1 bit): Specifies whether the FontEffects property is stored in the DataBlock.FontEffects of the TextProps that contains this TextPropsPropMask.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsPropMask
source_rows.text: C - fFontHeight (1 bit): Specifies whether the FontHeight property is stored in the DataBlock.FontHeight of the TextProps that contains this TextPropsPropMask.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsPropMask
source_rows.text: D - UnusedBits1 (1 bit): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsPropMask
source_rows.text: E - fFontCharSet (1 bit): Specifies whether the FontCharSet property is stored in the DataBlock.FontCharSet of the TextProps that contains this TextPropsPropMask.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsPropMask
source_rows.text: F - fFontPitchAndFamily (1 bit): Specifies whether the FontPitchAndFamily property is stored in the DataBlock.FontPitchAndFamily of the TextProps that contains this TextPropsPropMask.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsPropMask
source_rows.text: G - fParagraphAlign (1 bit): Specifies whether the ParagraphAlign property is stored in the DataBlock.ParagraphAlign of the TextProps that contains this TextPropsPropMask.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsPropMask
source_rows.text: H - fFontWeight (1 bit): Specifies whether the FontWeight property is stored in the DataBlock.FontWeight of the TextProps that contains this TextPropsPropMask.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsPropMask
source_rows.text: UnusedBits2 (24 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsDataBlock
source_rows.text: Specifies the text properties of the control that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not set to the file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the TextProps that contains this TextPropsDataBlock is set to zero, the property value MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsDataBlock
source_rows.text: FontName (4 bytes): A CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag that specifies the size and compression of the FontName property.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsDataBlock
source_rows.text: FontEffects (4 bytes): An fmFontEffects that specifies the value of the FontEffects property.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsDataBlock
source_rows.text: FontHeight (4 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the value of the FontHeight property.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsDataBlock
source_rows.text: FontCharSet (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the value of the FontCharSet property.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsDataBlock
source_rows.text: FontPitchAndFamily (1 byte): An fmFontPitchAndFamily that specifies the value of the FontPitchAndFamily property.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsDataBlock
source_rows.text: ParagraphAlign (1 byte): A PARAFORMAT_Alignment that specifies the value of the ParagraphAlign property.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding1 (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to align the following property, as specified by PaddingAndAlignment.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsDataBlock
source_rows.text: FontWeight (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the value of the FontWeight property.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsDataBlock
source_rows.text: Padding2 (variable): MUST be set to zero. The size of this field is the least number of bytes required to make the total size, in bytes, of this TextPropsDataBlock divisible by 4.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: Specifies the text properties of the control that are larger than 4 bytes and are not set to the file format defaults. If the corresponding bit in the PropMask of the TextProps that contains this TextPropsExtraDataBlock is set to zero, the property value MUST NOT be stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: TextPropsExtraDataBlock
source_rows.text: FontName (variable): An fmString that specifies the FontName property. The size and compression of the string is specified by the DataBlock.FontName of the TextProps that contains this TextPropsExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: Property Types
source_rows.text: Specifies data types that are used by more than one control.

source_rows.heading: fmPosition
source_rows.text: Specifies a pair of signed integers that specify a position relative to a reference point.

source_rows.heading: fmPosition
source_rows.text: Left (4 bytes): A signed integer that specifies, in HIMETRIC units, a distance to the right of the reference point.

source_rows.heading: fmPosition
source_rows.text: Top (4 bytes): A signed integer that specifies, in HIMETRIC units, a distance below the reference point.

source_rows.heading: fmSize
source_rows.text: Specifies a pair of signed integers that specify the size of a control.

source_rows.heading: fmSize
source_rows.text: Width (4 bytes): A signed integer that specifies the width, in HIMETRIC units, of the control.

source_rows.heading: fmSize
source_rows.text: Height (4 bytes): A signed integer that specifies the height, in HIMETRIC units, of the control.

source_rows.heading: FONTFLAGS
source_rows.text: Specifies a bit field that specifies style characteristics of a font.

source_rows.heading: FONTFLAGS
source_rows.text: A - FONT_fBold (1 bit): Specifies whether the font style is bold. MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: FONTFLAGS
source_rows.text: B - FONT_fItalic (1 bit): Specifies whether the font style is italic.

source_rows.heading: FONTFLAGS
source_rows.text: C - FONT_fUnderline (1 bit): Specifies whether the font style is underlined.

source_rows.heading: FONTFLAGS
source_rows.text: D - FONT_fStrikethrough (1 bit): Specifies whether the font style is strikethrough.

source_rows.heading: FONTFLAGS
source_rows.text: Unused (4 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: FormEmbeddedActiveXControl
source_rows.text: Specifies a control based on the value of a DataBlock.ClsidCacheIndex of an OleSiteConcreteControl that is referenced by a FormControl.

source_rows.heading: FormEmbeddedActiveXControl
source_rows.text: ControlCached (variable): A FormEmbeddedActiveXControlCached that is specified by the ClsidCacheIndex property. If the value of the ClsidCacheIndex property is greater than or equal to 0x7FFF, this field MUST NOT be stored.

source_rows.heading: FormEmbeddedActiveXControl
source_rows.text: ControlNonCached (variable): A control that is specified by an index into the FormSiteData.ClassTable of the FormControl that references this FormEmbeddedActiveXControl. This control MUST be able to interact through OLE Automation, as specified in [MS-OAUT]. If the value of the ClsidCacheIndex property is less than 0x8000, this field MUST NOT be stored.

source_rows.heading: FormEmbeddedActiveXControlCached
source_rows.text: Specifies the type of embedded control for values of the ClsidCacheIndex property less than 0x7FFF. Parent controls are stored as specified in section 2.1.2.2.2. Controls that cannot be parents are stored as specified in section 2.1.2.2.1.

source_rows.heading: FormFont
source_rows.text: Specifies the font type to load based on the FontGUID of the GuidAndFont that contains this structure. The value of FontGUID is stored as specified by [MS-DTYP] section 2.3.4.2, but it is displayed in the following table using Curly Braced GUID String Syntax, as specified by [MS-DTYP] section 2.3.4.3.

source_rows.heading: FormFont
source_rows.text: Specifies that the Font of the GuidAndFont that contains this FormFont is a StdFont.

source_rows.heading: FormFont
source_rows.text: Specifies that the Font of the GuidAndFont that contains this FormFont is a TextProps.

source_rows.heading: GuidAndFont
source_rows.text: A GUID and a FormFont that specify the StreamData for the Font property.

source_rows.heading: GuidAndFont
source_rows.text: FontGUID (16 bytes): A GUID, as specified in [MS-DTYP] section 2.3.4, that specifies the type of font that is stored in Font. MUST be the GUID of one of the types of FormFont.

source_rows.heading: GuidAndFont
source_rows.text: Font (variable): A FormFont that specifies a font.

source_rows.heading: GuidAndPicture
source_rows.text: Specifies a combination of a GUID, as specified in [MS-DTYP] section 2.3.4, and a StdPicture that specify the StreamData for both the MouseIcon and Picture properties.

source_rows.heading: GuidAndPicture
source_rows.text: CLSID_StdPicture (16 bytes): A GUID, as specified in [MS-DTYP] section 2.3.4. MUST be set to {0BE35204-8F91-11CE-9DE3-00AA004BB851}.

source_rows.heading: GuidAndPicture
source_rows.text: StdPicture (variable): A StdPicture that specifies the picture data for either the MouseIcon or Picture property.

source_rows.heading: OLE_COLOR
source_rows.text: RgbColorOrPaletteEntry (3 bytes): An RgbColorOrPaletteEntry that specifies either the red, green, and blue values of a color or an index into a color palette, based on the value of OleColorType.

source_rows.heading: OLE_COLOR
source_rows.text: OleColorType (1 byte): An OleColorType that specifies the meaning of RgbColorOrPaletteEntry.

source_rows.heading: OleColorType
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of the OleColorType enumeration and their meanings with respect to an RgbColorOrPaletteEntry.

source_rows.heading: OleColorType
source_rows.text: Specifies that the client application determines whether the RgbColorOrPaletteEntry is a PaletteEntry, in which case Red MUST be set to zero, or an RgbColor, in which case Red specifies the red value of a color.

source_rows.heading: OleColorType
source_rows.text: Specifies that the GreenAndBlueOrPaletteIndex is an index into a client application color palette and that Red MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: OleColorType
source_rows.text: Specifies that GreenAndBlueOrPaletteIndex specifies the green and blue values of a color, where the low-order byte specifies blue and the high-order byte specifies green, and that Red specifies the red value of a color.

source_rows.heading: OleColorType
source_rows.text: Specifies that GreenAndBlueOrPaletteIndex is an index into the system color palette and that Red MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: RgbColorOrPaletteEntry
source_rows.text: Specifies the red, green, and blue values of a color or an index into a color palette, based on the value of an associated OleColorType.

source_rows.heading: RgbColorOrPaletteEntry
source_rows.text: GreenAndBlueOrPaletteIndex (2 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the green and blue values of a color or an index into a color palette. If the value of the associated OleColorType is PaletteEntry or SystemPalette, or if the value is set to Default and the client application determines that the color is a PaletteEntry, this field is an index into the corresponding color palette. Otherwise, the low-order byte specifies the blue value of a color and the high-order byte specifies the green value of the color.

source_rows.heading: RgbColorOrPaletteEntry
source_rows.text: Red (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the red value of a color. If the value of the associated OleColorType is PaletteEntry or SystemPalette, or if the value is set to Default and the client application determines that the color is a PaletteEntry, this field MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: StdFont
source_rows.text: Specifies the format of a standard font structure as persisted to a stream.

source_rows.heading: StdFont
source_rows.text: Version (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the version of StdFont that is stored in the file. MUST be set to 1.

source_rows.heading: StdFont
source_rows.text: sCharset (2 bytes): A signed integer that specifies the character set of the font.

source_rows.heading: StdFont
source_rows.text: bFlags (1 byte): A FONTFLAGS that specifies style characteristics of the font.

source_rows.heading: StdFont
source_rows.text: sWeight (2 bytes): A signed integer that specifies the weight of the font. MUST be in the range from zero through 1000. A value of zero specifies that the weight is to be determined by the application. A value in the range from 1 through 1000 specifies a weight, where 1 specifies the lightest type and 1000 specifies the darkest type.

source_rows.heading: StdFont
source_rows.text: ulHeight (4 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the height, in ten-thousandths of a point, of the font. MUST be greater than zero and less than or equal to 655350000.

source_rows.heading: StdFont
source_rows.text: bFaceLen (1 byte): An unsigned integer that specifies the length, in bytes, of FontFace. MUST be less than 32.

source_rows.heading: StdFont
source_rows.text: FontFace (variable): An ASCII string that specifies the name of the font.

source_rows.heading: StdPicture
source_rows.text: Specifies a picture as persisted to a stream.

source_rows.heading: StdPicture
source_rows.text: Preamble (4 bytes): MUST be set to 0x0000746C.

source_rows.heading: StdPicture
source_rows.text: Size (4 bytes): An unsigned integer that specifies the size, in bytes, of Picture.

source_rows.heading: StdPicture
source_rows.text: Picture (variable): A sequence of bytes that specify a picture. The length of the sequence is Size. The bytes MUST specify a picture in one of the following formats:

source_rows.heading: Strings
source_rows.text: Properties that are strings are persisted to a stream with two structures. All string values are Unicode strings, which can be stored compressed or uncompressed.

source_rows.heading: Strings
source_rows.text: The first structure specifies the size of the string and whether it is compressed. If the string is stored in an array, the structure MUST be a CountOfCharsWithCompressionFlag; otherwise, the structure MUST be a CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag.

source_rows.heading: Strings
source_rows.text: When the high-order byte of every character in a string is set to 0x00, the string is compressible. Zero-length strings are not compressible. All string property values that are compressible MUST be stored as compressed strings. The compression algorithm removes all bytes that are set to 0x00 from the string. The size of a compressed string is the size after compression.

source_rows.heading: Strings
source_rows.text: A zero-length string is specified by a CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag that is set to zero for both cb and fCompressed or a CountOfCharsWithCompressionFlag that is set to zero for both cch and fCompressed.

source_rows.heading: Strings
source_rows.text: The second structure is an fmString, which stores the characters of the string, after compression if compressible.

source_rows.heading: Strings
source_rows.text: Strings MUST NOT store null terminators and MUST NOT count null terminators in the cb of the CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag or the cch of the CountOfCharsWithCompressionFlag.

source_rows.heading: ArrayString
source_rows.text: Specifies the size, format, and contents of a string that is persisted to a stream as part of an array. The CountOfCharsWithCompressionFlag is stored directly preceding the fmString.

source_rows.heading: ArrayString
source_rows.text: CountAndCompression (4 bytes): A CountOfCharsWithCompressionFlag that specifies the size and format of the string that follows.

source_rows.heading: ArrayString
source_rows.text: UncompressedString (variable): An fmString that is not compressed. If the CountAndCompression.fCompressed of this ArrayString is set to 1 or the CountAndCompression.cch of this ArrayString is set to zero, this fmString MUST NOT be stored.

source_rows.heading: ArrayString
source_rows.text: CompressedString (variable): An fmString that is compressed. If the CountAndCompression.fCompressed of this ArrayString is set to zero or the CountAndCompression.cch of this ArrayString is set to zero, this fmString MUST NOT be stored.

source_rows.heading: ArrayString
source_rows.text: Padding (variable): Undefined and MUST be ignored. The size of this array is the least number of bytes required to make the total size, in bytes, of this ArrayString divisible by 4.

source_rows.heading: CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag
source_rows.text: Specifies the size of an fmString and whether the string is compressed.

source_rows.heading: CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag
source_rows.text: cb (31 bits): An unsigned integer that specifies the size of the string in bytes. The size of a compressed string is the size after compression.

source_rows.heading: CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag
source_rows.text: A - fCompressed (1 bit): Specifies whether the string is compressed.

source_rows.heading: CountOfCharsWithCompressionFlag
source_rows.text: Specifies the size of an fmString in an array and whether or not the string is compressed.

source_rows.heading: CountOfCharsWithCompressionFlag
source_rows.text: cch (31 bits): An unsigned integer that specifies the number of characters in the string.

source_rows.heading: CountOfCharsWithCompressionFlag
source_rows.text: A - fCompressed (1 bit): Specifies whether the string is compressed.

source_rows.heading: fmString
source_rows.text: An array of characters that specifies the value of a Unicode string. The size of the string is specified by the cb of the CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag or the cch of the CountOfCharsWithCompressionFlag associated with this string. Whether the characters are those of a compressed string is specified by the fCompressed of the CountOfBytesWithCompressionFlag or CountOfCharsWithCompressionFlag associated with this fmString.

source_rows.heading: Property Definitions
source_rows.text: This section specifies the properties that can be persisted as part of storing a control, regardless of the type of file to which it is persisted. Each property applies to one or more control types and MUST NOT be persisted with controls to which they do not apply. The value of a property that is not stored is specified to be the file format default of that property. Property values that are the same as the file format default MUST NOT be stored.

source_rows.heading: Property Definitions
source_rows.text: In the context of persisting controls to a property bag, as specified in section 2.1.1.1, the name of each property is the same as the name of its section, excluding words or phrases in parentheses. The file format defaults are shown in the format used by persisting controls to a stream, as specified in section 2.1.1.2, but properties saved to a property bag are still persisted as specified in section 2.1.1.1.

source_rows.heading: Accelerator
source_rows.text: A Unicode character that specifies the accelerator key for the control.

source_rows.heading: Accelerator
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x0000, no accelerator.

source_rows.heading: Accelerator
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | CommandButton | Label | OptionButton | TabStrip | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: AutoSize
source_rows.text: A Boolean value that specifies whether the control automatically resizes to display its entire contents.

source_rows.heading: AutoSize
source_rows.text: The file format default is FALSE.

source_rows.heading: AutoSize
source_rows.text: This property applies only to the Image control. Other controls use the AutoSize field of the VariousPropertyBits property.

source_rows.heading: BackColor
source_rows.text: An OLE_COLOR that specifies the background color of the control.

source_rows.heading: BackColor
source_rows.text: The file format default is specified as follows:

source_rows.heading: BackColor
source_rows.text: COLOR_3DFACE from the system palette, equivalent to COLOR_BTNFACE.

source_rows.heading: BackColor
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | CommandButton | Form | Image | Label | ListBox | OptionButton | ScrollBar | SpinButton | TabStrip | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: BitFlags (OleSiteConcrete)
source_rows.text: A SITE_FLAG that specifies Boolean properties of an embedded control on a form.

source_rows.heading: BitFlags (OleSiteConcrete)
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00000033, which means that the following flags are set to TRUE: fTabStop, fVisible, fStreamed, and fAutoSize.

source_rows.heading: SITE_FLAG
source_rows.text: Specifies Boolean properties of an embedded control on a form. Unless otherwise specified, each bit applies to all control types. All bits that do not apply to a particular type of control MUST be set to zero for that control.

source_rows.heading: SITE_FLAG
source_rows.text: A - fTabStop (1 bit): Specifies whether the control can receive focus while the user is navigating controls using the TAB key.

source_rows.heading: SITE_FLAG
source_rows.text: B - fVisible (1 bit): Specifies whether the control is displayed.

source_rows.heading: SITE_FLAG
source_rows.text: C - fDefault (1 bit): Specifies whether the control is the default option on the form.

source_rows.heading: SITE_FLAG
source_rows.text: D - fCancel (1 bit): Specifies whether the control is the cancel option on the form.

source_rows.heading: SITE_FLAG
source_rows.text: E - fStreamed (1 bit): Specifies whether the control is stored in the Object stream of the form. A value of zero specifies that the control has its own storage.

source_rows.heading: SITE_FLAG
source_rows.text: F - fAutoSize (1 bit): Specifies whether the control automatically resizes to display its entire contents.

source_rows.heading: SITE_FLAG
source_rows.text: G - Unused1 (2 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: SITE_FLAG
source_rows.text: H - fPreserveHeight (1 bit): Specifies whether to preserve the height of a control when resizing. Applies to ListBox.

source_rows.heading: SITE_FLAG
source_rows.text: I - fFitToParent (1 bit): Specifies whether to adjust the size of a control when the size of its parent changes.

source_rows.heading: SITE_FLAG
source_rows.text: J - Reserved1 (3 bits): MUST be set to zero and MUST be ignored.

source_rows.heading: SITE_FLAG
source_rows.text: K - fSelectChild (1 bit): Specifies whether to select the first child of a container control when the container control is the next control to which the user is navigating.

source_rows.heading: SITE_FLAG
source_rows.text: Unused2 (4 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: SITE_FLAG
source_rows.text: L - fPromoteControls (1 bit): Specifies whether child controls are identified as child objects of the control or as child objects of the parent of the control. MUST be set to 1 for the following controls: Frame, MultiPage and Page. MUST be set to zero for all other controls.

source_rows.heading: SITE_FLAG
source_rows.text: Unused3 (13 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: BitFlags (DesignExtender)
source_rows.text: A DX_MODE that specifies Boolean design-time properties of a UserForm.

source_rows.heading: BitFlags (DesignExtender)
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00015F55, which means that the following flags are set to TRUE:

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: Specifies Boolean design-time properties of a UserForm.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: A - fInheritDesign (1 bit): Specifies whether the form has the same value as the client application design surface settings for fDesign.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: B - fDesign (1 bit): Specifies whether the form is currently in design mode.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: C - fInheritShowToolbox (1 bit): Specifies whether the form has the same value as the client application design-time settings for fShowToolbox.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: D - fShowToolbox (1 bit): Specifies whether the toolbox is visible.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: E - fInheritShowGrid (1 bit): Specifies whether the form has the same value as the client application design-time settings for fShowGrid.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: F - fShowGrid (1 bit): Specifies whether to display a grid on the design surface of the form.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: G - fInheritSnapToGrid (1 bit): Specifies whether the form has the same value as the client application design-time settings for fSnapToGrid.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: H - fSnapToGrid (1 bit): Specifies whether to keep controls on the form in positions that are on the grid.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: I - fInheritGridX (1 bit): Specifies whether the form has the same value as the client application design-time settings for DataBlock.GridX.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: J - fInheritGridY (1 bit): Specifies whether the form has the same value as the client application design-time settings for DataBlock.GridY.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: K - fInheritClickControl (1 bit): Specifies whether the form has the same value as the client application design-time settings for DataBlock.ClickControlMode.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: L - fInheritDblClickControl (1 bit): Specifies whether the form has the same value as the client application design-time settings for DataBlock.DblClickControlMode.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: M - fInheritShowInvisible (1 bit): Specifies whether the form has the same value as the client application design-time settings for fShowInvisible.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: N - fShowInvisible (1 bit): Specifies whether to display controls that have been marked as not visible.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: O - fInheritShowTooltips (1 bit): Specifies whether the form has the same value as the client application design-time settings for fShowTooltips.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: P - fShowTooltips (1 bit): Specifies whether to display tooltips for controls on the design surface.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: Q - fInheritLayoutImmediate (1 bit): Specifies whether the form has the same value as the client application design-time settings for fLayoutImmediate.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: R - fLayoutImmediate (1 bit): Specifies whether to update the design surface after a property has changed.

source_rows.heading: DX_MODE
source_rows.text: Unused (14 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: BooleanProperties
source_rows.text: A FormFlags that specifies Boolean properties of a form.

source_rows.heading: BooleanProperties
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00000004, FORM_FLAG_ENABLED set to TRUE.

source_rows.heading: FormFlags
source_rows.text: A bit field that specifies Boolean properties of a form.

source_rows.heading: FormFlags
source_rows.text: A - Unused1 (2 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: FormFlags
source_rows.text: B - FORM_FLAG_ENABLED (1 bit): Specifies whether the form is enabled.

source_rows.heading: FormFlags
source_rows.text: Unused2 (11 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: FormFlags
source_rows.text: C - FORM_FLAG_DESINKPERSISTED (1 bit): Specifies whether Design Extender properties are persisted with this form.

source_rows.heading: FormFlags
source_rows.text: D - FORM_FLAG_DONTSAVECLASSTABLE (1 bit): Specifies whether the Class Table of a form is not persisted. A value of zero specifies that the Class Table is persisted if it is not empty.

source_rows.heading: FormFlags
source_rows.text: Unused3 (16 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: BorderColor
source_rows.text: An OLE_COLOR that specifies the color of the border of the control.

source_rows.heading: BorderColor
source_rows.text: The file format default is specified in the following table.

source_rows.heading: BorderColor
source_rows.text: Applies to: ComboBox | Form | Image | Label | ListBox | TextBox

source_rows.heading: BorderStyle
source_rows.text: An fmBorderStyle that specifies the type of border used by the control.

source_rows.heading: BorderStyle
source_rows.text: The file format default is specified in the following table.

source_rows.heading: BorderStyle
source_rows.text: Applies to: ComboBox | Form | Image | Label | ListBox | TextBox

source_rows.heading: fmBorderStyle
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of the fmBorderStyle enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmBorderStyle
source_rows.text: The control has no visible border line.

source_rows.heading: fmBorderStyle
source_rows.text: The control has a single-line border.

source_rows.heading: BoundColumn
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies how the Value property is determined for a ComboBox or ListBox when the MultiSelect property is set to 0x00 (fmMultiSelectSingle). The possible values for this property are specified in the following table.

source_rows.heading: BoundColumn
source_rows.text: Specifies that the value of the Value property is the row number of the selected row. Rows are numbered starting from zero.

source_rows.heading: BoundColumn
source_rows.text: Specifies the number of the column in the selected row whose data is the value of the Value property. Columns are numbered starting from 1.

source_rows.heading: BoundColumn
source_rows.text: When the MultiSelect property is not set to 0x00 (fmMultiSelectSingle), BoundColumn has no effect on the Value property.

source_rows.heading: Caption
source_rows.text: An fmString that specifies the descriptive text that appears on a control to identify or describe it.

source_rows.heading: Caption
source_rows.text: The file format default is a zero-length string.

source_rows.heading: Caption
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | CommandButton | Form<2> | Label | OptionButton | TabStrip | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: cColumnInfo
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the last column with a non-default width. Columns are counted starting at 1. A value of zero specifies that all columns have the default width.

source_rows.heading: ClickControlMode
source_rows.text: An fmClickControlMode that specifies control behavior when the control is clicked.

source_rows.heading: ClickControlMode
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00, fmClickControlModeInsertionPoint.

source_rows.heading: fmClickControlMode
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmClickControlMode
source_rows.text: Use the same value as the client application design-time settings.

source_rows.heading: fmClickControlMode
source_rows.text: Use the client application default value.

source_rows.heading: fmClickControlMode
source_rows.text: Select the control under the cursor, and set the insertion point under the cursor, both on the same click.

source_rows.heading: fmClickControlMode
source_rows.text: If the control under the cursor is already selected, set the insertion point under the cursor; otherwise, select the control.

source_rows.heading: ClsidCacheIndex
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the type of a FormEmbeddedActiveXControl on a parent control. A value less than 0x7FFF specifies an index value for FormEmbeddedActiveXControlCached. A value of 0x7FFF specifies that the index is invalid. A value greater than or equal to 0x8000 specifies an index into the FormSiteData.ClassTable of the FormControl in which the control is embedded, where information about the control is specified by the entry in ClassTable that corresponds to the value of this property minus 0x8000.

source_rows.heading: ClsidCacheIndex
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x7FFF, an invalid index.

source_rows.heading: ColumnCount
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies the number of columns to display in a ComboBox or ListBox. A value of –1 specifies that all columns are to be displayed. MUST be in the range from –1 through 32767.

source_rows.heading: ControlSource
source_rows.text: An fmString that specifies a cell in a worksheet that sets the Value property of a control when the control is loaded and to which the new value of the Value property is stored after it changes in the control.

source_rows.heading: ControlSource
source_rows.text: The file format default is a zero-length string.

source_rows.heading: Cycle
source_rows.text: An fmCycle that specifies the behavior of the TAB key in the last control of a form.

source_rows.heading: Cycle
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00, fmCycleAllForms.

source_rows.heading: fmCycle
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of the fmCycle enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmCycle
source_rows.text: The focus is next set to the first control on the next form, returning to the first control of this form only after all controls on all other forms have been reached.

source_rows.heading: fmCycle
source_rows.text: The focus is next set to the first control on this form, ignoring other forms.

source_rows.heading: Delay
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the delay, in milliseconds, between successive scroll or value-change events when a user clicks and holds down a button on a ScrollBar or SpinButton.

source_rows.heading: Delay
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00000032, 50 milliseconds.

source_rows.heading: DblClickControlMode
source_rows.text: An fmDblClickControlMode that specifies the behavior when the user double-clicks a form or an item on the form.

source_rows.heading: DblClickControlMode
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00, fmDblClickControlModeSelectText.

source_rows.heading: fmDblClickControlMode
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmDblClickControlMode
source_rows.text: Use the same value as the client application design-time settings.

source_rows.heading: fmDblClickControlMode
source_rows.text: Select any text that is under the cursor.

source_rows.heading: fmDblClickControlMode
source_rows.text: Display and set focus to the code associated with the control that is under the cursor.

source_rows.heading: fmDblClickControlMode
source_rows.text: Display the properties of the control that is under the cursor.

source_rows.heading: DisplayedSize
source_rows.text: An fmSize that specifies the physical size, in HIMETRIC units, of a displayed form. Controls can exist on the form outside of this size.<3>

source_rows.heading: DisplayedSize
source_rows.text: The file format default is a width of 4000, 113.4 points, and a height of 3000, 85 points.

source_rows.heading: DisplayStyle
source_rows.text: An fmDisplayStyle that specifies the type of a MorphDataControl.

source_rows.heading: DisplayStyle
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x01, fmDisplayStyleText.

source_rows.heading: DisplayStyle
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | ListBox | OptionButton | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: fmDisplayStyle
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmDisplayStyle
source_rows.text: A ComboBox control in which the TextBox part is directly editable.<4>

source_rows.heading: fmDisplayStyle
source_rows.text: A ComboBox control in which the TextBox part is not editable except by selecting a different value from the ListBox part.<5>

source_rows.heading: DrawBuffer
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the number of pixels in a buffer into which the form can be drawn. MUST be in the range from 16000 through 1048576.

source_rows.heading: DrawBuffer
source_rows.text: Each Form MUST persist a value for this property.

source_rows.heading: DropButtonStyle
source_rows.text: An fmDropButtonStyle that specifies the symbol displayed on the drop button in a ComboBox. SHOULD be set to 0x01 (fmDropButtonStyleArrow) for TextBox controls.<6>

source_rows.heading: DropButtonStyle
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x01, fmDropButtonStyleArrow.

source_rows.heading: fmDropButtonStyle
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmDropButtonStyle
source_rows.text: Displays a button with no symbol.

source_rows.heading: fmDropButtonStyle
source_rows.text: Displays a button with a down arrow.

source_rows.heading: fmDropButtonStyle
source_rows.text: Displays a button with an ellipsis (...).

source_rows.heading: fmDropButtonStyle
source_rows.text: Displays a button with a horizontal line like an underscore character.

source_rows.heading: Flags
source_rows.text: A Boolean value that specifies whether the control is enabled.

source_rows.heading: Flags
source_rows.text: The file format default is TRUE, control is enabled.

source_rows.heading: Font
source_rows.text: A GuidAndFont that specifies the font to use in a control.

source_rows.heading: Font
source_rows.text: The file format default is not to store a font.

source_rows.heading: FontCharSet
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the character set of the text displayed by the control that contains the TextProps to which this property applies.

source_rows.heading: FontEffects
source_rows.text: An fmFontEffects that specifies the visual attributes of the text displayed by the control that contains the TextProps to which this property applies.

source_rows.heading: FontEffects
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00000000, no effects set.

source_rows.heading: fmFontEffects
source_rows.text: Specifies the possible values of the FontEffects property.

source_rows.heading: fmFontEffects
source_rows.text: A - fBold (1 bit): Specifies whether the Bold effect has been applied to the font.

source_rows.heading: fmFontEffects
source_rows.text: B - fItalic (1 bit): Specifies whether the Italic effect has been applied to the font.

source_rows.heading: fmFontEffects
source_rows.text: C - fUnderline (1 bit): Specifies whether the Underline effect has been applied to the font.

source_rows.heading: fmFontEffects
source_rows.text: D - fStrikeout (1 bit): Specifies whether the Strikeout effect has been applied to the font.

source_rows.heading: fmFontEffects
source_rows.text: UnusedBits1 (9 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: fmFontEffects
source_rows.text: E - fDisabled (1 bit): Specifies whether the Disabled effect has been applied to the font.

source_rows.heading: fmFontEffects
source_rows.text: UnusedBits2 (16 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: fmFontEffects
source_rows.text: F - fAutoColor (1 bit): Specifies whether the AutoColor effect has been applied to the font.

source_rows.heading: fmFontEffects
source_rows.text: G - UnusedBits3 (1 bit): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: FontHeight
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the height, in twips, of the text displayed by the control that contains the TextProps to which this property applies. MUST be less than or equal to 4294967.

source_rows.heading: FontHeight
source_rows.text: The file format default is 160, an 8-point font.

source_rows.heading: FontName
source_rows.text: An fmString that specifies the font of the text displayed by the control that contains the TextProps to which this property applies.

source_rows.heading: FontName
source_rows.text: The file format default is MS Sans Serif.

source_rows.heading: FontPitchAndFamily
source_rows.text: An fmFontPitchAndFamily that specifies the character pitch and the font family of the text displayed by the control that contains the TextProps to which this property applies.

source_rows.heading: FontPitchAndFamily
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00, DEFAULT_PITCH, FF_DONTCARE.

source_rows.heading: fmFontPitchAndFamily
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer specifying character pitch and font family. The four low-order bits specify the character pitch of a font, and the four high-order bits specify the font family.

source_rows.heading: fmFontPitchAndFamily
source_rows.text: Pitch (4 bits): Specifies the character pitch of a font. MUST be a value specified in fmFontPitch.

source_rows.heading: fmFontPitchAndFamily
source_rows.text: Family (4 bits): Specifies the font family of a font. MUST be a value specified in fmFontFamily.

source_rows.heading: fmFontPitch
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of the fmFontPitch enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmFontPitch
source_rows.text: Does not specify a character pitch. Behavior is determined by the client application using this field.

source_rows.heading: fmFontPitch
source_rows.text: All characters have the same width.

source_rows.heading: fmFontFamily
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of the fmFontFamily enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmFontFamily
source_rows.text: Specifies that the default font is used.

source_rows.heading: fmFontFamily
source_rows.text: Specifies that fonts with variable stroke width (proportional) and with serifs are used.

source_rows.heading: fmFontFamily
source_rows.text: Specifies that fonts with variable stroke width (proportional) and without serifs are used.

source_rows.heading: fmFontFamily
source_rows.text: Specifies that fonts with constant stroke width (monospace), with or without serifs are used.

source_rows.heading: fmFontFamily
source_rows.text: Specifies that fonts designed to look like handwriting are used.

source_rows.heading: fmFontFamily
source_rows.text: Specifies that novelty fonts are used.

source_rows.heading: FontWeight
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the font weight of the text displayed by the control that contains the TextProps to which this property applies. The value MUST be in the range from zero through 1000. A value of zero specifies that the weight is determined by the application. A value from 1 through 1000 specifies a weight, where 1 specifies the lightest type and 1000 specifies the darkest type.

source_rows.heading: ForeColor
source_rows.text: An OLE_COLOR that specifies the foreground color of the control.

source_rows.heading: ForeColor
source_rows.text: The file format default is specified in the following table.

source_rows.heading: ForeColor
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | CommandButton | Form | Label | ListBox | OptionButton | ScrollBar | SpinButton | TabStrip | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: GridX
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies the horizontal distance, in HIMETRIC units, between points on the design surface grid. A value of zero specifies that no grid is displayed. If this value for a control is set to zero, GridY MUST also be set to zero for that control.

source_rows.heading: GridY
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies the vertical distance, in HIMETRIC units, between points on the design surface grid. A value of zero specifies that no grid is displayed. If this value for a control is set to zero, GridX MUST also be set to zero for that control.

source_rows.heading: GroupCount
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the number of control groups on a form.

source_rows.heading: GroupCount
source_rows.text: The file format default is zero.

source_rows.heading: GroupID
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the control group of a control. A value of zero specifies that the control is not in a control group. A value greater than zero specifies the unique identifier of the control group to which the control belongs. All controls that have the same value for this property are in the same control group.

source_rows.heading: GroupName
source_rows.text: An fmString that specifies a group of mutually exclusive controls.

source_rows.heading: GroupName
source_rows.text: The file format default is a zero-length string.

source_rows.heading: HelpContextID
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies a context that can be used to direct Help to a specific category or article for an embedded control on a form.

source_rows.heading: ID
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies a unique identifier for an embedded control on a form.

source_rows.heading: LargeChange
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies the amount by which the Position property changes when the user clicks between the scroll box and scroll arrow.

source_rows.heading: ListIndex
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies the index of the selected tab, where zero is the first tab. The value MUST be less than the number of items in the control.

source_rows.heading: ListIndex
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0xFFFFFFFF, –1, which specifies that no tab is selected.

source_rows.heading: ListRows
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the maximum number of rows to display in the list.

source_rows.heading: ListStyle
source_rows.text: An fmListStyle that specifies the visual appearance of the list in a ListBox or ComboBox.

source_rows.heading: ListStyle
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00, fmListStylePlain.

source_rows.heading: fmListStyle
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmListStyle
source_rows.text: Displays a list in which the background of an item is highlighted when it is selected.

source_rows.heading: fmListStyle
source_rows.text: Displays a list in which an option button (when the MultiSelect property is set to fmMultiSelectSingle) or a checkbox (when the MultiSelect property is fmMultiSelectMulti or fmMultiSelectExtended) next to each entry displays the selection state of that item.

source_rows.heading: ListWidth
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the width, in HIMETRIC units, of the ListBox part of a ComboBox control. The value SHOULD be set to zero for ListBox controls. A value of zero specifies that the ListBox part is the same width as the TextBox part.<7>

source_rows.heading: ListWidth
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00, matches the TextBox part.

source_rows.heading: LogicalSize
