source_rows.text: An fmSize that specifies the full scrollable size, in HIMETRIC units, of a form, including all controls. A value of zero in either width or height specifies that the scrollable size is equivalent to the value of the corresponding portion of DisplayedSize.

source_rows.heading: LogicalSize
source_rows.text: The file format default is a width of 4000, 113.4 points and a height of 3000, 85 points.

source_rows.heading: MatchEntry
source_rows.text: An fmMatchEntry that specifies how a ListBox or ComboBox searches its list as the user types.

source_rows.heading: MatchEntry
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x02, fmMatchEntryNone.

source_rows.heading: fmMatchEntry
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmMatchEntry
source_rows.text: The control searches for the next entry that starts with the character entered. Repeatedly typing the same letter cycles through all entries beginning with that letter.

source_rows.heading: fmMatchEntry
source_rows.text: As each character is typed, the control searches for an entry matching all characters entered.

source_rows.heading: fmMatchEntry
source_rows.text: The list is not searched when characters are typed.

source_rows.heading: Max
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies the maximum acceptable value for the Position property of a ScrollBar or SpinButton.

source_rows.heading: Max
source_rows.text: The file format default is specified in the following table.

source_rows.heading: MaxLength
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the maximum number of characters that a user can enter in a TextBox or ComboBox. A value of zero specifies no limit.

source_rows.heading: MaxLength
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00000000, no limit.

source_rows.heading: Min
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies the minimum acceptable value for the Position property of a ScrollBar or SpinButton.

source_rows.heading: MouseIcon
source_rows.text: A GuidAndPicture that specifies a custom icon to display as the mouse pointer for the control, which is used when the value of the MousePointer property is set to 99, fmMousePointerCustom.

source_rows.heading: MouseIcon
source_rows.text: The file format default is no custom icon.

source_rows.heading: MouseIcon
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | CommandButton | Form | Image | Label | ListBox | OptionButton | ScrollBar | SpinButton | TabStrip | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: MousePointer
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the type of icon displayed as the mouse pointer for the control. SHOULD be a value from the fmMousePointer enumeration.<8>

source_rows.heading: MousePointer
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00, fmMousePointerDefault.

source_rows.heading: MousePointer
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | CommandButton | Form | Image | Label | ListBox | OptionButton | ScrollBar | SpinButton | TabStrip | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: fmMousePointer
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmMousePointer
source_rows.text: Double arrow pointing northeast and southwest.

source_rows.heading: fmMousePointer
source_rows.text: Double arrow pointing north and south.

source_rows.heading: fmMousePointer
source_rows.text: Double arrow pointing northwest and southeast.

source_rows.heading: fmMousePointer
source_rows.text: Double arrow pointing west and east.

source_rows.heading: fmMousePointer
source_rows.text: "Not" symbol (circle with a diagonal line) on top of the object being dragged.

source_rows.heading: fmMousePointer
source_rows.text: "Size-all" cursor (arrows pointing north, south, east, and west).

source_rows.heading: fmMousePointer
source_rows.text: Uses the icon specified by the MouseIcon property.

source_rows.heading: MultiRow
source_rows.text: A Boolean value that specifies whether the tabs of a control can be displayed in more than one row.

source_rows.heading: MultiRow
source_rows.text: The file format default is FALSE, display tabs in one row.

source_rows.heading: MultiSelect
source_rows.text: An fmMultiSelect that specifies whether the control permits multiple selections. SHOULD be set to 0x00 (fmMultiSelectSingle) for CheckBox, OptionButton, and ToggleButton controls.<9>

source_rows.heading: MultiSelect
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00, fmMultiSelectSingle.

source_rows.heading: MultiSelect
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ListBox | OptionButton | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: fmMultiSelect
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmMultiSelect
source_rows.text: Only one item can be selected.

source_rows.heading: fmMultiSelect
source_rows.text: Pressing the SPACEBAR or clicking selects or deselects an item in the list.

source_rows.heading: fmMultiSelect
source_rows.text: Pressing SHIFT and clicking the mouse, or pressing SHIFT and one of the arrow keys, extends the selection from the previously selected item to the current item. Pressing CTRL and clicking the mouse selects or deselects an item.

source_rows.heading: Name
source_rows.text: An fmString that specifies the name of a control.

source_rows.heading: Name
source_rows.text: The file format default is a zero-length string.

source_rows.heading: NewVersion
source_rows.text: A Boolean value that specifies whether the control is persisted with a TextProps.

source_rows.heading: NewVersion
source_rows.text: The file format default is FALSE. TabStrip controls MUST specify a value of TRUE for this property.

source_rows.heading: NextAvailableID
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the largest ID that has been used by an embedded control on a form. The value of this property can be used by the client application to determine the next valid ID for a new control.

source_rows.heading: NextEnabled
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies whether a control is enabled, that is, whether it can receive the focus and respond to user-generated events. The value of this property MUST be equal to the value of PrevEnabled.

source_rows.heading: NextEnabled
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00000001, the control is enabled.

source_rows.heading: ObjectStreamSize
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the size, in bytes, of an embedded control that is persisted to the Object stream of a Form.

source_rows.heading: Orientation
source_rows.text: An fmOrientation that specifies whether the SpinButton or ScrollBar is oriented vertically or horizontally.

source_rows.heading: Orientation
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0xFFFFFFFF, fmOrientationAuto.

source_rows.heading: fmOrientation
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmOrientation
source_rows.text: Control is rendered horizontally when the width of the control is greater than its height. The control is rendered vertically otherwise.

source_rows.heading: PageCount
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies the number of Pages in a control. A value less than zero specifies an invalid number of Pages.

source_rows.heading: PageCount
source_rows.text: The MultiPage control to which this property applies MUST persist this property.

source_rows.heading: ParagraphAlign
source_rows.text: A PARAFORMAT_Alignment that specifies the horizontal justification of the text used by the control.

source_rows.heading: ParagraphAlign
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x01, PFA_LEFT.

source_rows.heading: PARAFORMAT_Alignment
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: PARAFORMAT_Alignment
source_rows.text: The text used by the control is aligned to the left.

source_rows.heading: PARAFORMAT_Alignment
source_rows.text: The text used by the control is aligned to the right.

source_rows.heading: PARAFORMAT_Alignment
source_rows.text: The text used by the control is aligned to the center.

source_rows.heading: PasswordChar
source_rows.text: A Unicode character that specifies a character to be displayed in place of the characters entered in a TextBox. The null character specifies that the control displays the characters that the user types.

source_rows.heading: PasswordChar
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x0000, display the characters the user types.

source_rows.heading: Picture
source_rows.text: A GuidAndPicture that specifies the picture to display on a control.

source_rows.heading: Picture
source_rows.text: The file format default is no picture.

source_rows.heading: Picture
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | CommandButton | Form | Image | Label | OptionButton | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: PictureAlignment
source_rows.text: An fmPictureAlignment that specifies the alignment of the picture in the Form or Image.

source_rows.heading: PictureAlignment
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x02, fmPictureAlignmentCenter.

source_rows.heading: fmPictureAlignment
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: PicturePosition
source_rows.text: An fmPicturePosition that specifies the location of the picture of a control relative to the caption of the control.

source_rows.heading: PicturePosition
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00070001, fmPicturePositionAboveCenter.

source_rows.heading: PicturePosition
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | CommandButton | Label | OptionButton | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: fmPicturePosition
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmPicturePosition
source_rows.text: The picture appears to the left of the caption. The caption is aligned with the top of the picture.

source_rows.heading: fmPicturePosition
source_rows.text: The picture appears to the left of the caption. The caption is centered relative to the picture.

source_rows.heading: fmPicturePosition
source_rows.text: The picture appears to the left of the caption. The caption is aligned with the bottom of the picture.

source_rows.heading: fmPicturePosition
source_rows.text: The picture appears to the right of the caption. The caption is aligned with the top of the picture.

source_rows.heading: fmPicturePosition
source_rows.text: The picture appears to the right of the caption. The caption is centered relative to the picture.

source_rows.heading: fmPicturePosition
source_rows.text: The picture appears to the right of the caption. The caption is aligned with the bottom of the picture.

source_rows.heading: fmPicturePosition
source_rows.text: The picture appears above the caption. The caption is aligned with the left edge of the picture.

source_rows.heading: fmPicturePosition
source_rows.text: The picture appears above the caption. The caption is centered below the picture.

source_rows.heading: fmPicturePosition
source_rows.text: The picture appears above the caption. The caption is aligned with the right edge of the picture.

source_rows.heading: fmPicturePosition
source_rows.text: The picture appears below the caption. The caption is aligned with the left edge of the picture.

source_rows.heading: fmPicturePosition
source_rows.text: The picture appears below the caption. The caption is centered above the picture.

source_rows.heading: fmPicturePosition
source_rows.text: The picture appears below the caption. The caption is aligned with the right edge of the picture.

source_rows.heading: fmPicturePosition
source_rows.text: The picture appears in the center of the control. The caption is centered horizontally and vertically above the picture.

source_rows.heading: PictureSizeMode
source_rows.text: An fmPictureSizeMode that specifies how to display the picture.

source_rows.heading: PictureSizeMode
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00, fmPictureSizeModeClip.

source_rows.heading: fmPictureSizeMode
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmPictureSizeMode
source_rows.text: Crops any part of the picture that is larger than the control boundaries.

source_rows.heading: fmPictureSizeMode
source_rows.text: Stretches the picture to fill the control area. This setting distorts the picture in either the horizontal or vertical direction.

source_rows.heading: fmPictureSizeMode
source_rows.text: Enlarges the picture, but does not distort the picture in either the horizontal or vertical direction.

source_rows.heading: PictureTiling
source_rows.text: A Boolean value that specifies whether the picture is tiled across the background.

source_rows.heading: PictureTiling
source_rows.text: The file format default is FALSE.

source_rows.heading: Position (ScrollBar and SpinButton)
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies the value of a ScrollBar or SpinButton control.<10> MUST be greater than or equal to the smaller of Min and Max, and MUST be less than or equal to the greater of Min and Max.

source_rows.heading: Position (OleSiteConcrete)
source_rows.text: An fmPosition that specifies the location of the top-left corner of an embedded control on a form, relative to the top-left corner of the LogicalSize of the form.

source_rows.heading: Position (OleSiteConcrete)
source_rows.text: The file format default is (0, 0), which specifies that the top-left corner of the embedded control is at the top-left corner of the form.

source_rows.heading: PrevEnabled
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies whether a control is enabled, that is, whether it can receive the focus and respond to user-generated events. A value of zero specifies that the control is not enabled. A value of 1 specifies that the control is enabled. If the control persists a value for the VariousPropertyBits property and the value of VariousPropertiesBitfield.Enabled is set to zero, the value of this property MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: PrevEnabled
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00000001, the control is enabled.

source_rows.heading: ProportionalThumb
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies the size of the scroll box. MUST be set to either 0xFFFF or 0x0000. A value of 0xFFFF specifies that the scroll box is proportional in size to the scrolling region. A value of 0x0000 specifies that the size of the scroll box is fixed.

source_rows.heading: ProportionalThumb
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0xFFFF, scroll box proportionally sized.

source_rows.heading: RowSource
source_rows.text: An fmString that specifies the source for the list of values in a ComboBox or ListBox that is embedded in a form. This property MUST NOT be set for other controls. The format of the string is a range of cells in a worksheet.

source_rows.heading: RowSource
source_rows.text: The file format default is a zero-length string.

source_rows.heading: RuntimeLicKey
source_rows.text: An fmString that specifies the license key of a control.

source_rows.heading: RuntimeLicKey
source_rows.text: The file format default is a zero-length string.

source_rows.heading: ScrollBars (UserForm)
source_rows.text: A FormScrollBarFlags that specifies whether a form has vertical or horizontal scroll bars and when to display them.

source_rows.heading: ScrollBars (UserForm)
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x0000000C, fScrollBarsKeepHorizontal and fScrollBarsKeepVertical.

source_rows.heading: FormScrollBarFlags
source_rows.text: A bit field that specifies the location of the scroll bars of a form.

source_rows.heading: FormScrollBarFlags
source_rows.text: A - fScrollBarsHorizontal (1 bit): Specifies whether the horizontal scroll bar is displayed.

source_rows.heading: FormScrollBarFlags
source_rows.text: B - fScrollBarsVertical (1 bit): Specifies whether the vertical scroll bar is displayed.

source_rows.heading: FormScrollBarFlags
source_rows.text: C - fScrollBarsKeepHorizontal (1 bit): Specifies whether to display the horizontal scroll bar at all times, even when all controls are visible without scrolling.

source_rows.heading: FormScrollBarFlags
source_rows.text: D - fScrollBarsKeepVertical (1 bit): Specifies whether to display the vertical scroll bar at all times, even when all controls are visible without scrolling.

source_rows.heading: FormScrollBarFlags
source_rows.text: E - fScrollBarsKeepLeft (1 bit): Specifies whether to display the vertical scroll bar on the left side of the form.

source_rows.heading: FormScrollBarFlags
source_rows.text: F - Unused (3 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: ScrollBars (MorphData)
source_rows.text: An fmScrollBars that specifies whether the control has vertical scroll bars, horizontal scroll bars, both, or neither. MUST be set to 0x03 (fmScrollBarsBoth) for ListBox controls.

source_rows.heading: ScrollBars (MorphData)
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00, fmScrollBarsNone.

source_rows.heading: fmScrollBars
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmScrollBars
source_rows.text: Displays both a horizontal and a vertical scroll bar.

source_rows.heading: ScrollPosition
source_rows.text: An fmPosition that specifies, in HIMETRIC units, the coordinates of the first point in the LogicalSize of the form that is visible.

source_rows.heading: ScrollPosition
source_rows.text: The file format default is a position of (0, 0), which specifies that the form has not been scrolled.

source_rows.heading: ShapeCookie
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the number of times the dynamic type information of a form has changed. The value of this property can be used to determine whether a form being loaded still matches the dynamic type information against which it was compiled.

source_rows.heading: ShowDropButtonWhen
source_rows.text: An fmShowDropButtonWhen that specifies when to show the drop button for a ComboBox.

source_rows.heading: ShowDropButtonWhen
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00, fmShowDropButtonWhenNever.

source_rows.heading: fmShowDropButtonWhen
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmShowDropButtonWhen
source_rows.text: Show the drop button when the control has the focus.

source_rows.heading: fmShowDropButtonWhen
source_rows.text: Show the drop button at all times.

source_rows.heading: Size
source_rows.text: An fmSize that specifies width and height, in HIMETRIC units, of the control.

source_rows.heading: Size
source_rows.text: Each control to which this property applies MUST persist a value for it.

source_rows.heading: Size
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | CommandButton | Image | Label | ListBox | OptionButton | TabStrip | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: SmallChange
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies the amount by which the Position property changes when the user clicks either scroll arrow in a ScrollBar or SpinButton.

source_rows.heading: SpecialEffect
source_rows.text: An fmSpecialEffect that specifies the visual appearance of the control. MUST be set to 0x02 for ToggleButton controls.

source_rows.heading: SpecialEffect
source_rows.text: The file format default is specified in the following table.

source_rows.heading: SpecialEffect
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | Form | Image | Label | ListBox | OptionButton | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: fmSpecialEffect
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings. In this enumeration, "form" refers to the surface on which the control appears.

source_rows.heading: fmSpecialEffect
source_rows.text: Control appears to be raised up from the form.

source_rows.heading: fmSpecialEffect
source_rows.text: Control appears to be carved into the form.

source_rows.heading: fmSpecialEffect
source_rows.text: The control border appears to be carved into the form.

source_rows.heading: fmSpecialEffect
source_rows.text: The control border appears to be raised up from the form.

source_rows.heading: TabData
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the number of tabs in a control for which a TabStripTabFlag is stored. MUST be less than or equal to the number of tabs in the control.

source_rows.heading: TabFixedHeight
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the height, in HIMETRIC units, of each tab in a TabStrip. The value applies to all tabs and MUST be less than or equal to 254000.<11>

source_rows.heading: TabFixedHeight
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00000000, which specifies that the client application determines the height.

source_rows.heading: TabFixedWidth
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the width, in HIMETRIC units, of each tab in a TabStrip. The value applies to all tabs and MUST be less than or equal to 254000. <12>

source_rows.heading: TabFixedWidth
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00000000, which specifies that the client application determines the width.

source_rows.heading: TabIndex
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies the index of an embedded control in the tab order of a form. Values less than zero specify an invalid index in the tab order.

source_rows.heading: TabIndex
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0xFFFF, or –1, an invalid index.

source_rows.heading: TabOrientation
source_rows.text: An fmTabOrientation that specifies the position of the tabs of a form, relative to the control.

source_rows.heading: TabOrientation
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00000000, fmTabOrientationTop.

source_rows.heading: fmTabOrientation
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmTabOrientation
source_rows.text: The tabs are above the control.

source_rows.heading: fmTabOrientation
source_rows.text: The tabs are below the control.

source_rows.heading: fmTabOrientation
source_rows.text: The tabs are to the left of the control.

source_rows.heading: fmTabOrientation
source_rows.text: The tabs are to the right of the control.

source_rows.heading: TabsAllocated
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the number of tabs that have been inserted since the control was created.

source_rows.heading: TabStyle
source_rows.text: An fmTabStyle that specifies the display style of the tabs of a control.

source_rows.heading: TabStyle
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00000000, fmTabStyleTabs.

source_rows.heading: fmTabStyle
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: Tag
source_rows.text: An fmString that is associated with a control and that contains data entered by the user. SHOULD be ignored.<13>

source_rows.heading: Tag
source_rows.text: The file format default is a zero-length string.

source_rows.heading: TakeFocusOnClick
source_rows.text: A Boolean value that specifies whether the control takes the focus when clicked.

source_rows.heading: TakeFocusOnClick
source_rows.text: The file format default is TRUE.

source_rows.heading: TextColumn
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies the column in a ComboBox or ListBox to display to the user. The possible values for this property are specified as follows:

source_rows.heading: TextColumn
source_rows.text: Specifies that the first column that has a Width greater than zero is displayed.

source_rows.heading: TextColumn
source_rows.text: Specifies that row numbers are displayed.

source_rows.heading: TextColumn
source_rows.text: Specifies the number of the column whose data is displayed.

source_rows.heading: TextColumn
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0xFFFF, show first column with width greater than zero.

source_rows.heading: Tooltip
source_rows.text: An fmString that specifies the tooltip for the control.

source_rows.heading: Tooltip
source_rows.text: The file format default is a zero-length string.

source_rows.heading: Tooltips
source_rows.text: A Boolean value that specifies whether to display the tooltips of a TabStrip control.

source_rows.heading: Tooltips
source_rows.text: The file format default is TRUE.

source_rows.heading: TransitionEffect
source_rows.text: An fmTransitionEffect that specifies the effect displayed when the user switches between pages in a control.

source_rows.heading: TransitionEffect
source_rows.text: The file format default is 0x00000000, fmTransitionEffectNone.

source_rows.heading: fmTransitionEffect
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: TransitionPeriod
source_rows.text: An unsigned integer that specifies the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the current page remains visible before switching to the new page that the user requested. MUST be in the range from zero through 10000.

source_rows.heading: Value
source_rows.text: An fmString that specifies the state or content of a control, as specified in the following table.

source_rows.heading: Value
source_rows.text: Whether the item is selected. Set to 1 to specify that the control is selected. Set to zero to specify that the control is cleared. Any other string specifies that the control is neither selected nor cleared.

source_rows.heading: Value
source_rows.text: The value in the BoundColumn of the currently selected row when MultiSelect is set to 0x00 (fmMultiSelectSingle). MUST be a zero-length string for other values of MultiSelect, or when there is no selected row, or when BoundColumn is greater than the number of columns.

source_rows.heading: Value
source_rows.text: The file format default is a zero-length string.

source_rows.heading: Value
source_rows.text: Applies to<14>: CheckBox | ComboBox | ListBox | OptionButton | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertyBits
source_rows.text: A VariousPropertiesBitfield that specifies the values of multiple properties on a control. Many of the fields in this structure apply to some types of controls, but not all types. All fields that do not apply to a particular type of control MUST be set to zero for that control.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertyBits
source_rows.text: The file format default is specified in the following table.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertyBits
source_rows.text: Properties set to 1 in file format default

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertyBits
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox| CommandButton | Image | Label | ListBox | OptionButton | ScrollBar | SpinButton | TabStrip | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: A - Reserved1 (1 bit): MUST be set to 1 and MUST be ignored.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | CommandButton | Image | Label | ListBox | OptionButton | ScrollBar | SpinButton | TabStrip | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: B - Enabled (1 bit): Specifies whether the control can receive the focus and respond to user-generated events.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | CommandButton | Image | Label | ListBox | OptionButton | ScrollBar | SpinButton | TabStrip | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: C - Locked (1 bit): Specifies whether data in the control is locked for editing.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | CommandButton | ListBox | OptionButton | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: D - BackStyle (1 bit): Specifies the background style for this control. A value of 1 specifies that the control is opaque, and a value of zero specifies that the control is transparent. MUST be set to 1 for the following controls: ListBox, TabStrip, ScrollBar, SpinButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | CommandButton | Image | Label | ListBox | OptionButton | ScrollBar | SpinButton | TabStrip | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: E - Reserved2 (1 bit): MUST be set to 1 and MUST be ignored.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | CommandButton | Image | Label | ListBox | OptionButton | ScrollBar | SpinButton | TabStrip | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: UnusedBits1 (5 bits): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: F - ColumnHeads (1 bit): Specifies whether column headings are displayed.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: G - IntegralHeight (1 bit): For ListBox and TextBox controls, specifies whether the control shows only complete lines of text. MUST be set to 1 for the following controls: CheckBox, OptionButton, and ToggleButton.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ListBox | OptionButton | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: H - MatchRequired (1 bit): Specifies whether a value entered into the TextBox part of a ComboBox is required to match an entry in the ListBox part of the control.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: I - Alignment (1 bit): Specifies the position of the Caption relative to the control. A value of 1 specifies that the Caption is to the left of the control, and a value of zero specifies that the Caption is to the right of the control.<15>

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: J - Editable (1 bit): Specifies whether the user can type into the control. MUST be set to 1 for TextBox controls. MUST be set to 1 for ComboBox controls in which the DisplayStyle property is set to 0x03 (fmDisplayStyleCombo). SHOULD be set to zero for ComboBox controls in which the DisplayStyle property is set to 0x07 (fmDisplayStyleDropList), but MAY be set to 1, and MUST be ignored.<16>

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: IMEMode (4 bits): An fmIMEMode that specifies the default run-time mode of the Input Method Editor (IME) for the control as it receives focus.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: Applies to<17>: CheckBox | ComboBox | CommandButton | Image | Label | ListBox | OptionButton | ScrollBar | SpinButton | TabStrip | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: K - DragBehavior (1 bit): Specifies whether dragging and dropping is enabled for the control.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: L - EnterKeyBehavior (1 bit): Specifies the behavior of the ENTER key. A value of 1 specifies that pressing ENTER creates a new line. A value of zero specifies that pressing ENTER moves the focus to the next object in the tab order.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: M - EnterFieldBehavior (1 bit): Specifies selection behavior when entering the control. A value of 1 specifies that the selection remains unchanged from the last time that the control was active. A value of zero specifies that all text in the control is selected when entering the control.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: N - TabKeyBehavior (1 bit): Specifies whether tab characters can exist in the text of the control. A value of 1 specifies that pressing the TAB key inserts a tab character into the text of the control. A value of zero specifies that pressing the TAB key moves the focus to the next object in the tab order.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: O - WordWrap (1 bit): Specifies whether the contents of the control automatically wrap at the end of a line. MUST be set to 1 for the following controls: ComboBox and ListBox.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | CommandButton | Label | ListBox | OptionButton | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: P - UnusedBits2 (1 bit): MUST be set to zero.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: Q - BordersSuppress (1 bit): SHOULD be set to zero.<18>

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | ListBox | OptionButton | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: R - SelectionMargin (1 bit): Specifies whether the user can select a line of text by clicking in the region to the left of the text. MUST be set to 1 for the following controls: CheckBox, ListBox, OptionButton, and ToggleButton.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | ListBox | OptionButton | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: S - AutoWordSelect (1 bit): Specifies the basic unit used to extend a selection. A value of 1 specifies that the basic unit is a single character. A value of zero specifies that the basic unit is a whole word. MUST be set to 1 for the following controls: CheckBox, ListBox, OptionButton, and ToggleButton.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | ListBox | OptionButton | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: T - AutoSize (1 bit): Specifies whether the control automatically resizes to display its entire contents.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: This bit does not apply to the Image control and MUST be set to zero for that type of control. The Image control uses a separate AutoSize property that is stored in the ImagePropMask.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | CommandButton | Label | OptionButton | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: U - HideSelection (1 bit): Specifies whether selected text in the control appears highlighted when the control does not have focus. MUST be set to 1 for the following controls: CheckBox, ListBox, OptionButton, and ToggleButton.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: Applies to: CheckBox | ComboBox | ListBox | OptionButton | TextBox | ToggleButton

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: V - AutoTab (1 bit): Specifies whether the focus automatically moves to the next control when the user enters the maximum number of characters specified by the MaxLength property.

source_rows.heading: VariousPropertiesBitfield
source_rows.text: W - MultiLine (1 bit): Specifies whether the control can display more than one line of text.

source_rows.heading: fmIMEMode
source_rows.text: The following table specifies the values of this enumeration and their meanings.

source_rows.heading: fmIMEMode
source_rows.text: IME off. User cannot turn on IME by keyboard.

source_rows.heading: fmIMEMode
source_rows.text: IME on with full-width hiragana mode.

source_rows.heading: fmIMEMode
source_rows.text: IME on with full-width katakana mode.

source_rows.heading: fmIMEMode
source_rows.text: IME on with half-width katakana mode.

source_rows.heading: fmIMEMode
source_rows.text: IME on with full-width alphanumeric mode.

source_rows.heading: fmIMEMode
source_rows.text: IME on with half-width alphanumeric mode.

source_rows.heading: fmIMEMode
source_rows.text: IME on with full-width Hangul mode.

source_rows.heading: fmIMEMode
source_rows.text: IME on with half-width Hangul mode.

source_rows.heading: fmIMEMode
source_rows.text: IME on with full-width hanzi mode.

source_rows.heading: fmIMEMode
source_rows.text: IME on with half-width hanzi mode.

source_rows.heading: Width
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies the width of a column, in HIMETRIC units, in a ComboBox or ListBox. A value of –1 specifies that the client application determines the width.

source_rows.heading: Zoom
source_rows.text: A signed integer that specifies the magnification of embedded controls, in percentage points of the size of the parent control. MUST be greater than or equal to 10 (10 percent of actual size) and less than or equal to 400 (four times or 400 percent of actual size).

source_rows.heading: Zoom
source_rows.text: The file format default is 100, or actual size.

source_rows.heading: String Compression

source_rows.heading: String Compression

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: The following example shows a CommandButtonControl structure. The CommandButton is embedded in a UserForm and has the following properties set:

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: The Caption property is set to "CommandButton1".

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: The Height and Width properties are set to 36 points and 126 points, respectively.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: The MousePointer property is set to fmMousePointerCustomer.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: The MouseIcon property is set to a picture.<19>

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: Although this example uses the CommandButtonControl, the persistence of the data structures for this control can also be applied to other control types.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: The following table shows the top-level representation of the CommandButtonControl structure.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: The following are detailed examples of PropMask, DataBlock, ExtraDataBlock, and StreamData. An example of the TextProps structure has been omitted because it closely resembles this example.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: MinorVersion: 0x00 specifies the minor version of the control.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: MajorVersion: 0x02 specifies the major version of the control.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: cbCommandButton: 0x0024 specifies the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of PropMask, DataBlock, and ExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: The following table shows which properties of the CommandButtonControl are not set to the file format default. If a bit has is set to 1, the corresponding property value in the CommandButtonDataBlock is not the file format default and is stored in the file. If a bit is set to zero, the corresponding property value is the file format default and is not stored in the file. As previously described, the Caption, Size (Height and Width), MousePointer, and MouseIcon properties are set to a value different from the file format default, and only these bits are set to 1.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: fForeColor: Zero specifies that the value of the ForeColor property is the file format default and is not stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: fBackColor: Zero specifies that the value of the BackColor property is the file format default and is not stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: fVariousPropertyBits: Zero specifies that the value of the VariousPropertyBits property is the file format default and is not stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: fCaption: 1 specifies that the Caption property is set to a value that is not the file format default and is stored in the CommandButtonDataBlock and CommandButtonExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: fPicturePosition: Zero specifies that the value of the PicturePosition property is the file format default and is not stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: fSize: 1 specifies that the Size property is set to a value that is not the file format default and is stored in the CommandButtonExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: fMousePointer: 1 specifies that the MousePointer property is set to a value that is not the file format default and is stored in the CommandButtonDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: fAccelerator: Zero specifies that the value of the Accelerator property is the file format default and is not stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: fTakeFocusOnClick: Zero specifies that the value of the TakeFocusOnClick property is the file format default and is not stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: fMouseIcon: 1 specifies that the MouseIcon property is set to a value that is not the file format default and is stored in the CommandButtonStreamData.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: The following table shows the CommandButtonDataBlock. The DataBlock stores property values that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not the file format default. In this example, MousePointer is the only property whose value is stored in the DataBlock. For the Caption property, the length and compression flag of the Caption string are stored in the DataBlock, but the Caption string itself is stored in the CommandButtonExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: Caption.cb: 0x0000000E specifies that the size, after compression, of the Caption string in the CommandButtonExtraDataBlock is 14 bytes.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: Caption.fCompressed: 1 specifies that the Caption string in the CommandButtonExtraDataBlock is compressed.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: MousePointer: 0x63 specifies that the MousePointer has the value fmMousePointerCustom and the icon is specified in the MouseIcon property.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: Padding1: 1 byte of unused data needed for the value of the MousePointer property to align to an offset divisible by 2 from the beginning of the CommandButtonControl.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: MouseIcon: 0xFFFF specifies that the MouseIcon property is set.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: Padding2: Because the size of the CommandButtonDataBlock is divisible by 4, there is no need to add any padding at the end of the CommandButtonDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: The following table shows the CommandButtonExtraDataBlock. For this example, the Caption and Size properties are the only properties stored in the CommandButtonExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: Caption: “CommandButton1” specifies the compressed string for the Caption property.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: Padding: 2 bytes of unused data needed for the size of the compressed string to be divisible by 4.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: Size.Width: 0x0000115D specifies that the width of the CommandButtonControl is 4445 HIMETRIC units, or 126 points.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: Size.Height: 0x000004F6 specifies that the height of the CommandButtonControl is 1270 HIMETRIC units, or 36 points.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: The following table shows the CommandButtonStreamData. The StreamData stores picture properties of the CommandButtonControl. For this example, MouseIcon is the only picture property persisted.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: MouseIcon.CLSID_StdPicture: 04 52 E3 0B 91 8F CE 11 9D E3 00 AA 00 4B B8 51 specifies the CLSID of the StdPicture object in little-endian format. The CLSID in standard GUID [MS-DTYP] format is {0BE35204-8F91-11CE-9DE3-00AA004BB851}.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: MouseIcon.Preamble: 0x0000746C specifies a constant value for the StdPicture object.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: MouseIcon.Size: 0x000002FE specifies the size, in bytes, of Picture.

source_rows.heading: CommandButton
source_rows.text: MouseIcon.Picture: 00 00 02 00 01 00 20 20 ... specifies the embedded icon to be used for the MouseIcon property. The complete value of this property has been omitted for brevity. For this example, the contents of this property are the same as the contents of the up_l.cur file.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: The following example shows the structure of the "x" stream in the MultiPage Control. An example of the "f" stream and the "o" stream has been omitted because it closely resembles the UserForm example.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: The MultiPage Control in this example has two Pages. The first Page has the following properties:

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: The TransitionEffect property is set to fmTransitionEffectCoverUp.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: The TransitionPeriod property is set to 10 milliseconds.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: The following table shows the top-level representation of the "x" stream in the MultiPage Control.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: The following are detailed examples of PageProperties and MultiPageProperties.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: PageProperties: An array of PageProperties. The first PageProperties in this array is not used and is ignored. The second and third PageProperties in the array persist the properties of the first and second Pages in the control, respectively.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: The following table shows the structure of the second PageProperties in the PageProperties array. It persists the TransitionEffect and TransitionPeriod properties of the first Page inside the control.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: MinorVersion: 0x00 specifies the minor version of the control.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: MajorVersion: 0x02 specifies the major version of the control.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: cbPage: 0x000C specifies the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of PropMask and DataBlock.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: The following table shows the properties of the PageProperties that are not set to the file format default. If a bit is set to 1, the corresponding property value in the PageDataBlock is not the file format default and is stored in the file. If a bit is set to zero, the corresponding property value is the file format default and is not stored in the file. As previously described, the TransitionEffect and TransitionPeriod properties are set to a value different from the file format default, and only these bits are set to 1.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: fTransitionEffect: 1 specifies that the TransitionEffect property is set to a value that is not the file format default and is stored in the PageDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: fTransitionPeriod: 1 specifies that the TransitionPeriod property is set to a value that is not the file format default and is stored in the PageDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: The following table shows the PageDataBlock. The DataBlock stores property values that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not the file format default. In this example, the TransitionEffect and the TransitionPeriod are both stored in the DataBlock because each has a size of 4 bytes.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: TransitionEffect: 0x00000001 specifies that the value of the TransitionEffect property is fmTransitionEffectCoverUp.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: TransitionPeriod: 0x0000000A specifies that the value of the TransitionPeriod property is 10 milliseconds.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: The following table shows the MultiPageProperties structure, which persists the PageCount, ID, Flags and PageIDs properties of the control.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: MinorVersion: 0x00 specifies the minor version of the control.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: MajorVersion: 0x02 specifies the major version of the control.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: cbMultiPageControlProperties: 0x000C specifies the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of PropMask and DataBlock.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: The following table shows the properties of the MultiPageProperties that are not set to the file format default. If a bit is set to 1, the corresponding property value in the MultiPagePropertiesDataBlock is not the file format default and is stored in the file. If a bit is set to zero, the corresponding property value is the file format default and is not stored in the file. As previously described, the PageCount and ID properties are set to a value different from the file format default, and only these bits are set to 1.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: fPageCount: 1 specifies that the value of the PageCount property is stored in the MultiPagePropertiesDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: fID: 1 specifies that the value of the ID property is stored in the MultiPagePropertiesDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: fFlags: Zero specifies that the value of the Flags property is the file format default.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: The following table shows the MultiPagePropertiesDataBlock. The DataBlock stores property values that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not the file format default. In this example, the PageCount and the ID are both stored in the DataBlock.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: PageCount: 0x00000002 specifies that the value of the PageCount property is 2.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: ID: 0x00000002 specifies that the value of the ID property for this control is 2.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: The following table shows the PageIDs array. The table shows the value of the ID property for each of the two Pages inside the MultiPage Control in this example.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: ID1: 0x00000003 specifies that the value of the ID property of the first Page in this control is 3.

source_rows.heading: MultiPage Control
source_rows.text: ID2: 0x00000004 specifies that the value of the ID property of the second Page in this control is 4.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The following example shows a FormControl with an embedded RefEdit control. The RefEdit control is an ActiveX control that displays a range value that references cells in a datasheet.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The FormControl has the following properties set:

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The LogicalSize Height and Width properties are set to 1000 and 2000 points, respectively.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The DisplayedSize Height and Width properties are set to 132 and 166.5 points, respectively.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The DrawBuffer is set to 32000 pixels.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The DepthTypeCount is set to zero.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The ID of the embedded control is set to 1.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The Name of the embedded control is set to "RefEdit1".

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The TabIndex of the embedded control is set to zero.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The SitePosition Top and Left properties of the embedded control are set to 60 and 48 points, respectively.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The top-level structure of the embedded RefEdit control in the "o" stream is illustrated in the final figure, ObjectStream structure, in this section. The CommandButton Example (section 3.2) illustrates the persistence of an embedded control.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The top-level representation of a FormControl structure contains the following streams: "f", "o", "\002.1.2.4CompObj", and "vbFrame". The latter two streams are not persisted as part of FormControl and are not detailed in this example.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The following table shows the top-level representation of the Form stream in a FormControl structure. It displays the FormPropMask, FormDataBlock, FormExtraDataBlock, FormStreamData, and FormSiteData for this FormControl.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The following are detailed examples of the PropMask, DataBlock, ExtraDataBlock, StreamData and SiteData.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: Form.MinorVersion: 0x00 specifies the minor version of the control.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: Form.MajorVersion: 0x04 specifies the major version of the control.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: Form.cbForm: 0x0024 specifies that the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of PropMask, DataBlock, and ExtraDataBlock of this FormControl is 36.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The following table shows the properties of the FormControl that are not set to the file format default. If a bit is set to 1, the value of the corresponding property in the FormDataBlock or FormExtraDataBlock is not the file format default and is stored in the file. If a bit is set to zero, the value of the corresponding property is the file format default and is not stored in the file. The NextAvailableID, DisplayedSize, LogicalSize, Font, ShapeCookie, and DrawBuffer properties are set to a value different from the file format default, and only these bits are set to 1.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: Fields that are set to zero specify that their corresponding property is not stored; they have been omitted from the following description.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: fNextAvailableID: 1 specifies that the NextAvailableID property is not set to the file format default and is stored in the FormDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: fDisplayedSize: 1 specifies that the DisplayedSize property is not set to the file format default and is stored in the FormExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: fLogicalSize: 1 specifies that the LogicalSize property is not set to the file format default and is stored in the FormExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: fFont: 1 specifies that the Font property is not set to the file format default and is stored in the FormDataBlock and FormStreamData.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: fShapeCookie: 1 specifies that the ShapeCookie property is not set to the file format default and is stored in the FormDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: fDrawBuffer: 1 specifies that the DrawBuffer property is not set to the file format default and is stored in the FormDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The following table shows the FormDataBlock. The DataBlock stores property values that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not the file format defaults. In this example, NextAvailableID, Font, ShapeCookie, and DrawBuffer are the only properties stored in the DataBlock.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: NextAvailableID: 0x00000001 specifies that the largest ID that has been used by an embedded control on the form is 1, so the next available valid ID is 2.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: Font: 0xFFFF specifies that the Font property is stored in the FormStreamData.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: ShapeCookie: 0x00000001 specifies that the dynamic type information of a form has changed once.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: DrawBuffer: 0x00007D00 specifies that the number of pixels in a buffer into which the form can be drawn is 32000.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The following table shows the FormExtraDataBlock. For this example, the DisplayedSize and LogicalSize properties are the only properties stored in the FormExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: DisplayedSize.Width: 0x000016F2 specifies that the physical width of the FormControl is 5874 HIMETRIC units, or 166.5 points.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: DisplayedSize.Height: 0x00001231 specifies that the physical height of the FormControl is 4657 HIMETRIC units, or 132 points.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: LogicalSize.Width: 0x0001139C specifies that the scrollable width of the FormControl is 70556 HIMETRIC units, or 2000 points.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: LogicalSize.Height: 0x000089CE specifies that the scrollable height of the FormControl is 35278 HIMETRIC units, or 1000 points.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The following table shows the FormStreamData. The StreamData is used to store the Font property of the FormControl.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: FontGUID: 03 52 E3 0B 91 8F CE 11 9D E3 00 AA 00 4B B8 51 specifies, in little-endian format, that the CLSID of the FormFont is a StdFont. The CLSID in standard GUID [MS-DTYP] format is {0BE35203-8F91-11CE-9DE3-00AA004BB851}.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: StdFont.Version: 0x01 specifies the version of StdFont that is stored in the file.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: StdFont.sCharset: 0x0000 specifies the character set of the Font.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: StdFont.bFlags: 0x00 specifies that the Font style is not bold, italic, underlined, or crossed out.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: StdFont.sWeight: 0x0190 specifies that the weight of the Font is 400.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: StdFont.ulHeight: 0x00014244 specifies that the height of the Font is 8.25 points.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: StdFont.bFaceLen: 0x07 specifies the length, in bytes, of FontFace.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: StdFont.FontFace: "Verdana" specifies the name of the Font in ASCII characters.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The following table shows the FormSiteData, which is used to store the properties of embedded controls in a UserForm. This structure contains the SITE_TYPE of embedded controls and an array of OleSiteConcreteControls that describe these controls.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: CountOfSiteClassInfo: 0x0001 specifies that there is one element in ClassTable. This field is stored because the value of DataBlock.BooleanProperties.FORM_FLAG_DONTSAVECLASSTABLE in the FormControl that contains this FormSiteData is the file format default, zero.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: CountOfSites: 0x00000001 specifies that there is one element in Sites.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: CountOfBytes: 0x0000002C specifies that the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of the SiteDepthsAndTypes, ArrayPadding, and Sites of this FormSiteData is 44.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: SiteDepthsAndTypes.DepthTypeCount.Depth: 0x00 specifies that no controls exist in the hierarchy between the embedded control and the parent control.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: SiteDepthsAndTypes.DepthTypeCount.TypeOrCount: 0x01 specifies that the SITE_TYPE of the embedded control is ST_Ole.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: SiteDepthsAndTypes.DepthTypeCount.fCount: Zero specifies that TypeOrCount is not a count of consecutive embedded controls.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: ArrayPadding: 9D 9D are unused bytes that make the total size of SiteDepthsAndTypes divisible by 4.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: Sites.Site: Properties of the embedded control in the UserForm as persisted to a stream.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The following table shows the structure representation of the SiteClassInfo in a FormControl. It displays the PropMask, DataBlock and ExtraDataBlock for this SiteClassInfo. The ClsID, DispEvent, DefaultProg, and DispidBind members are set to a value different from the file format default, and only these bits are set to 1.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: PropMask bits set to zero specify that no value is stored in their corresponding field in the ClassInfoDataBlock or ClassInfoExtraDataBlock; they have been omitted from the following description.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: ClassInfo.Version: 0x0000 specifies the version of this SiteClassInfo.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: ClassInfo.cbClassTable: 0x0038 specifies that the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of ClassInfoPropMask, ClassInfoDataBlock, and ClassInfoExtraDataBlock in this ClassTable is 56.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: ClassInfo.PropMask.fClsID: 1 specifies that the ClsID field is not set to the file format default and is stored in the ClassInfoExtraDataBlock of the SiteClassInfo.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: ClassInfo.PropMask.fDispEvent: 1 specifies that the DispEvent field is not set to the file format default and is stored in the ClassInfoExtraDataBlock of SiteClassInfo.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: ClassInfo.PropMask.fDefaultProg: 1 specifies that the DefaultProg field is not set to the file format default and is stored in the ClassInfoExtraDataBlock of the SiteClassInfo.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: ClassInfo.PropMask.fDispidBind: 1 specifies that the DispidBind field is not set to the file format default and is stored in the ClassInfoDataBlock of the SiteClassInfo.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: ClassInfo.DataBlock.DispidBind: 0x00000000 specifies the DispID of the default bindable property, as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.49.5.2.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: ClassInfo.ExtraDataBlock.ClsID: 12 45 02 00 00 00 00 00 C0 00 00 00 00 00 00 46 specifies the CLSID of the RefEdit control in little-endian format. The GUID [MS-DTYP] in standard format is {00024512-0000-0000-C000-000000000046}.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: ClassInfo.ExtraDataBlock.DispEvent: 12 1D D2 8B 42 EC CE 11 9E 0D 00 AA 00 60 02 F3 specifies the GUID, in little-endian format, of the source interface as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.49.8. The GUID [MS-DTYP] in standard format is {8BD21D12-EC42-11CE-9E0D-00AA006002F3}.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: ClassInfo.ExtraDataBlock.DefaultProg: 18 45 02 00 00 00 00 00 C0 00 00 00 00 00 00 46 specifies the GUID, in little-endian format, of the default interface as specified in [MS-OAUT] section 2.2.49.8. The GUID [MS-DTYP] in standard format is {00024518-0000-0000-C000-000000000046}.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The following table shows the top-level representation of the OleSiteConcreteControl in a FormControl structure. It displays the PropMask, DataBlock and ExtraDataBlock for this OleSiteConcreteControl.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: Version: 0x0000 specifies the version of the OleSiteConcreteControl.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: cbSite: 0x0024 specifies that the sum of the sizes, in bytes, of SitePropMask, SiteDataBlock, and SiteExtraDataBlock in this OleSiteConcreteControl is 36.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The following table shows the properties of the OleSiteConcreteControl that are not set to the file format default. If a bit is set to 1, the value of the corresponding property in the SiteDataBlock or SiteExtraDataBlock is not the file format default and is stored in the file. If a bit is set to zero, the value of the corresponding property is the file format default and is not stored in the file. The Name, ID, ObjectStreamSize, TabIndex, ClsidCacheIndex, and Position properties are not set to the file format default, and only these bits are set to 1.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: PropMask fields set to zero specify that no property is stored and have been omitted from the following description.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: fName: 1 specifies that the Name property is not set to the file format default and is stored in the SiteDataBlock and SiteExtraDataBlock of the OleSiteConcreteControl.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: fID: 1 specifies that the ID property is not set to the file format default and is stored in the SiteDataBlock of the OleSiteConcreteControl.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: fObjectStreamSize: 1 specifies that the ObjectStreamSize property is not set to the file format default and is stored in the SiteDataBlock of the OleSiteConcreteControl.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: fTabIndex: 1 specifies that the TabIndex property is not set to the file format default and is stored in the SiteDataBlock of the OleSiteConcreteControl.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: fClsidCacheIndex: 1 specifies that the ClsidCacheIndex property is not set to the file format default and is stored in the SiteDataBlock of the OleSiteConcreteControl.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: fPosition: 1 specifies that the Position property is not set to the file format default and is stored in the SiteExtraDataBlock of the OleSiteConcreteControl.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: The following table shows the SiteDataBlock. The DataBlock stores property values that are 4 bytes or smaller and are not the file format defaults. In this example, ID, ObjectStreamSize, TabIndex, and ClsidCacheIndex are the only properties whose values are stored in the DataBlock. For the Name property, the length and compression flag of the Name string are stored in the DataBlock, but the Name string itself is stored in the SiteExtraDataBlock.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: NameData.cb: 0x00000008 specifies that the size of the Name string in the SiteExtraDataBlock is 8 bytes after compression.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: NameData.fCompressed: 1 specifies that the Name string in the SiteExtraDataBlock is compressed.

source_rows.heading: UserForm
source_rows.text: ID: 0x00000001 specifies a unique identifier for the embedded control on the form.

source_rows.heading: UserForm

[ECMA-376] part 1, section 15.2.9, describes embedded controls in an Office Open XML document. The only parts of the example that are controlled by Office Forms are the name of each property and the type and format of each property value.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: The information in this specification is applicable to the following Microsoft products or supplemental software. References to product versions include updates to those products.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: Exceptions, if any, are noted in this section. If an update version, service pack or Knowledge Base (KB) number appears with a product name, the behavior changed in that update. The new behavior also applies to subsequent updates unless otherwise specified. If a product edition appears with the product version, behavior is different in that product edition.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: Unless otherwise specified, any statement of optional behavior in this specification that is prescribed using the terms "SHOULD" or "SHOULD NOT" implies product behavior in accordance with the SHOULD or SHOULD NOT prescription. Unless otherwise specified, the term "MAY" implies that the product does not follow the prescription.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <1> Section 1.5: This persistence format provides interoperability with applications that create or read documents conforming to this structure, including Microsoft Word 97, Microsoft Word 2000, Microsoft Office Word 2003, Microsoft Excel 97, Microsoft Excel 2000, Microsoft Office Excel 2003, Microsoft PowerPoint 97, Microsoft PowerPoint 2000, and Microsoft Office PowerPoint 2003. This persistence format can also be used for interoperability with Microsoft Office Word 2007, Microsoft Word 2010, Microsoft Word 2013 and later, Microsoft Office Excel 2007, Microsoft Excel 2010, Microsoft Excel 2013 and later, Microsoft Office PowerPoint 2007, Microsoft PowerPoint 2010, or Microsoft PowerPoint 2013 and later when compatibility with these listed products is a primary concern.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <2> Section 2.5.10: Office Forms can store a caption in a FormControl, but UserForm controls viewed in Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications 5.0 (VBA 5.0) do not use it. Instead, VBA 5.0 stores the caption of a UserForm control in the VBFrame stream, as described in [MS-OVBA] section 2.3.5.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <3> Section 2.5.19: Office Forms displays the full physical size for all controls, but the stored value of DisplayedSize in a form does not include the window borders and is therefore smaller than the size actually displayed.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <4> Section 2.5.20.1: ComboBox controls with the Style property in the Properties Window of the designer set to "0 - fmStyleDropDownCombo" have a DisplayStyle of fmDisplayStyleCombo.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <5> Section 2.5.20.1: ComboBox controls with the Style property in the Properties Window of the designer set to "2 - fmStyleDropDownList" have a DisplayStyle of fmDisplayStyleDropList.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <6> Section 2.5.22: The object model for Office Forms has a hidden property on the TextBox control called "DropButtonStyle". It has no effect on the control, except that its value is part of the file format.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <7> Section 2.5.43: The object model for Office Forms has a hidden property on the ListBox control called "ListWidth". It has no effect on the control, except that its value is part of the file format.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <8> Section 2.5.50: Values greater than zero and less than 256 that are set through the Office Forms Object Model are persisted. Office Forms treats values that are not in the fmMousePointer enumeration as the file format default.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <9> Section 2.5.52: The object model for Office Forms has a hidden property on the CheckBox, OptionButton, and ToggleButton controls called "MultiSelect". It has no effect on these controls, except that its value is part of the file format.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <10> Section 2.5.67: Office Forms uses the term "Value" when referring to the Position property in ScrollBar and SpinButton controls. The numeric Position property has been documented as separate from Value to distinguish it from controls for which the Value property is a string.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <11> Section 2.5.82: Office Forms treats values less than 142, that is, less than 4 points, in the same way as a value of zero.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <12> Section 2.5.83: Office Forms treats values less than 142, that is, less than 4 points, in the same way as a value of zero.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <13> Section 2.5.88: Office Forms preserves the value of this property, but its value and usage are controlled by the user.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <14> Section 2.5.95: Office Forms uses the term "Value" when referring to the Position property in ScrollBar and SpinButton controls. The numeric Position property has been documented as separate from Value to distinguish it from controls for which the Value property is a string. Office Forms also uses "Value" in TabStrip controls to refer to the ListIndex property, which has been documented separately for the same reason.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <15> Section 2.5.96.1: Office Forms displays the two values for the Alignment property as "0 - fmAlignmentLeft" and "1 - fmAlignmentRight" in the Properties Window of the designer. However, the file format specifies that VariousPropertyBits.Alignment is set to 1 for "0 - fmAlignmentLeft" and set to zero for "1 - fmAlignmentRight".

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <16> Section 2.5.96.1: The Editable property of a ComboBox control is set to 1 when it is persisted with the DisplayStyle property set to fmDisplayStyleCombo. The Editable property is not set to zero when the control is persisted with the DisplayStyle property set to fmDisplayStyleDropList. Instead, it retains the same value for the Editable property as the value it had the last time it was persisted. Applications make requests to Office Forms controls to persist themselves at times other than when the user chooses to save a document, so the Editable property can be set to 1, even if the implementer changes the Style property of a new ComboBox to "2 - fmStyleDropDownList" in the Properties Window of the designer before saving.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <17> Section 2.5.96.1: Only the ComboBox, ListBox, and TextBox controls enable a user to directly manipulate the IMEMode property. However, other controls adjust the value of this property in response to WM_IME_NOTIFY messages.

source_rows.heading: Appendix A: Product Behavior
source_rows.text: <18> Section 2.5.96.1: The object model for Office Forms has a hidden Boolean property on all MorphDataControl-based controls called "BordersSuppress". It has no effect on the control, except that its value is part of the file format.
